HIDDEN = 5632
EPS = 1e-5
_DEVICE = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")


class Model(nn.Module):
    """
    Full pre-norm SwiGLU MLP transformer sub-block (Llama-style):
        h   = RMSNorm(x) * norm_weight            (stats in fp32, output cast to fp16)
        g   = h @ W_gate^T     [B, S, HIDDEN]
        u   = h @ W_up^T       [B, S, HIDDEN]
        a   = SiLU(g) * u
        y   = a @ W_down^T     [B, S, DIM]
        out = x + y                               (residual add)
    Beating torch.compile requires fusing RMSNorm into the GEMM prologue, merging the
    gate/up GEMMs with a SwiGLU epilogue, and fusing the residual into the down GEMM.
    """

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        self.eps = EPS
        gen = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(1234)
        norm_w = 1.0 + 0.05 * torch.randn(DIM, generator=gen)
        w_gate = torch.randn(HIDDEN, DIM, generator=gen) * (DIM ** -0.5)
        w_up = torch.randn(HIDDEN, DIM, generator=gen) * (DIM ** -0.5)
        w_down = torch.randn(DIM, HIDDEN, generator=gen) * (HIDDEN ** -0.5)

        self.w_gate = nn.Parameter(w_gate.to(device=_DEVICE, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.w_up = nn.Parameter(w_up.to(device=_DEVICE, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.w_down = nn.Parameter(w_down.to(device=_DEVICE, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)

    def forward(self, x):
        # RMSNorm with fp32 statistics
        h = x.float()
        h = h * torch.rsqrt(h.pow(2).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + self.eps)
        h = (h * self.norm_weight.float()).to(x.dtype)
        # SwiGLU MLP
        gate = torch.nn.functional.linear(h, self.w_gate)
        up = torch.nn.functional.linear(h, self.w_up)
        act = torch.nn.functional.silu(gate) * up
        out = torch.nn.functional.linear(act, self.w_down)
        # Residual
        return x + out


def get_inputs():
    gen = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(4321)
    x = torch.randn(BATCH, SEQ, DIM, generator=gen)
    return [x.to(device=_DEVICE, dtype=DT)]

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

DT = torch.float16


class Model(nn.Module):
    """Llama-style pre-norm causal self-attention block (fp16):
        n      = RMSNorm(x) * g
        q,k,v  = n @ Wqkv^T        (fused projection, 2048 -> 6144)
        q,k    = RoPE(q), RoPE(k)  (fp32 rotary math)
        a      = softmax(q k^T / sqrt(Dh) + causal) v   (32 heads, Dh=64)
        y      = x + a @ Wo^T      (output projection + residual)
    Shapes: B=4, H=32, S=2048, Dh=64, d_model=2048 -> x: (4, 2048, 2048)
    """
    B, H, S, Dh = 4, 32, 2048, 64
    C = H * Dh
    EPS = 1e-5
    ROPE_BASE = 10000.0
    SEED = 1234

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        dev = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
        g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(self.SEED)
        C, S, Dh = self.C, self.S, self.Dh
        std = C ** -0.5
        w_qkv = torch.randn(3 * C, C, generator=g, dtype=torch.float32) * std
        w_o = torch.randn(C, C, generator=g, dtype=torch.float32) * std
        norm_w = 1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(C, generator=g, dtype=torch.float32)
        self.norm_weight = nn.Parameter(norm_w.to(dev, dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.w_qkv = nn.Parameter(w_qkv.to(dev, dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.w_o = nn.Parameter(w_o.to(dev, dt), requires_grad=False)
        inv_freq = 1.0 / (self.ROPE_BASE ** (torch.arange(0, Dh, 2, dtype=torch.float32) / Dh))
        freqs = torch.outer(torch.arange(S, dtype=torch.float32), inv_freq)   # (S, Dh/2)
        emb = torch.cat([freqs, freqs], dim=-1)                                # (S, Dh)
        self.register_buffer("rope_cos", emb.cos()[None, None].to(dev), persistent=False)
        self.register_buffer("rope_sin", emb.sin()[None, None].to(dev), persistent=False)

    @staticmethod
    def _rotate_half(t):
        h = t.shape[-1] // 2
        return torch.cat([-t[..., h:], t[..., :h]], dim=-1)

    def forward(self, x):
        B, S, C = x.shape
        H, Dh = self.H, self.Dh
        # RMSNorm with fp32 statistics
        xf = x.float()
        n = xf * torch.rsqrt(xf.pow(2).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + self.EPS)
        n = (n * self.norm_weight.float()).to(x.dtype)
        # fused QKV projection -> (3, B, H, S, Dh)
        qkv = F.linear(n, self.w_qkv).view(B, S, 3, H, Dh).permute(2, 0, 3, 1, 4)
        q, k, v = qkv[0], qkv[1], qkv[2]
        # rotary position embedding (fp32 math) on q, k
        cos, sin = self.rope_cos[:, :, :S], self.rope_sin[:, :, :S]
        qf, kf = q.float(), k.float()
        q = (qf * cos + self._rotate_half(qf) * sin).to(x.dtype)
        k = (kf * cos + self._rotate_half(kf) * sin).to(x.dtype)
        # causal multi-head attention
        o = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v, is_causal=True)   # (B, H, S, Dh)
        o = o.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, S, C)
        # output projection + residual
        return x + F.linear(o, self.w_o)


def get_inputs():
    dev = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(Model.SEED + 1)
    x = torch.randn(Model.B, Model.S, Model.C, generator=g, dtype=torch.float32)
    return [x.to(dev, DT)]

import math
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

DT = torch.float16

BATCH = 8
SEQ = 2048
N_HEADS = 8          # query heads
N_KV_HEADS = 2       # key/value heads (GQA group size 4)
HEAD_DIM = 128
D_MODEL = N_HEADS * HEAD_DIM                       # 1024
QKV_DIM = (N_HEADS + 2 * N_KV_HEADS) * HEAD_DIM    # 1536
ROPE_BASE = 10000.0
EPS = 1e-6
SEED = 1234


def _device():
    return torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")


class Model(nn.Module):
    """
    Llama-style pre-norm grouped-query attention block (one tensor in, one tensor out):
        h    = RMSNorm(x) * g                       (fp32 statistics, fp16 output)
        qkv  = h @ Wqkv^T                           (fused Q|K|V projection: 8 Q heads / 2 KV heads, head_dim 128)
        q, k = RoPE(q), RoPE(k)                     (rotate-half convention, base 10000, fp32 tables)
        o    = softmax(q k^T / sqrt(128) + causal) v    (KV head j serves Q heads 4j..4j+3)
        y    = x + o @ Wo^T                         (output projection + residual)
    """

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        self.dt = dt
        dev = _device()
        g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(SEED)
        w_norm = 1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(D_MODEL, generator=g)
        w_qkv = torch.randn(QKV_DIM, D_MODEL, generator=g) / math.sqrt(D_MODEL)
        w_o = torch.randn(D_MODEL, D_MODEL, generator=g) / math.sqrt(D_MODEL)
        self.w_norm = nn.Parameter(w_norm.to(dev, dt))
        self.w_qkv = nn.Parameter(w_qkv.to(dev, dt))
        self.w_o = nn.Parameter(w_o.to(dev, dt))
        inv_freq = 1.0 / (ROPE_BASE ** (torch.arange(0, HEAD_DIM, 2, dtype=torch.float32) / HEAD_DIM))
        freqs = torch.outer(torch.arange(SEQ, dtype=torch.float32), inv_freq)   # (S, D/2)
        emb = torch.cat([freqs, freqs], dim=-1)                                 # (S, D)
        self.register_buffer("rope_cos", emb.cos().view(1, SEQ, 1, HEAD_DIM).to(dev), persistent=False)
        self.register_buffer("rope_sin", emb.sin().view(1, SEQ, 1, HEAD_DIM).to(dev), persistent=False)

    @staticmethod
    def _rotate_half(x):
        h = x.shape[-1] // 2
        return torch.cat([-x[..., h:], x[..., :h]], dim=-1)

    def _rope(self, x):                       # x: (B, S, H, D) fp16 -> fp16
        S = x.shape[1]
        xf = x.float()
        out = xf * self.rope_cos[:, :S] + self._rotate_half(xf) * self.rope_sin[:, :S]
        return out.to(self.dt)

    def forward(self, x):                     # x: (B, S, D_MODEL) fp16
        B, S, _ = x.shape
        dt = self.dt
        # --- RMSNorm (fp32 statistics) ---
        xf = x.float()
        h = (xf * torch.rsqrt(xf.pow(2).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + EPS)).to(dt) * self.w_norm
        # --- fused QKV projection ---
        qkv = F.linear(h, self.w_qkv)                                           # (B, S, 1536)
        q, k, v = torch.split(
            qkv, [N_HEADS * HEAD_DIM, N_KV_HEADS * HEAD_DIM, N_KV_HEADS * HEAD_DIM], dim=-1
        )
        q = q.reshape(B, S, N_HEADS, HEAD_DIM)
        k = k.reshape(B, S, N_KV_HEADS, HEAD_DIM)
        v = v.reshape(B, S, N_KV_HEADS, HEAD_DIM)
        # --- rotary position embedding on q, k ---
        q = self._rope(q).transpose(1, 2)                                       # (B, 8, S, 128)
        k = self._rope(k).transpose(1, 2)                                       # (B, 2, S, 128)
        v = v.transpose(1, 2)                                                   # (B, 2, S, 128)
        # --- grouped-query: KV head j serves Q heads 4j..4j+3 ---
        rep = N_HEADS // N_KV_HEADS
        k = k.repeat_interleave(rep, dim=1)                                     # (B, 8, S, 128)
        v = v.repeat_interleave(rep, dim=1)                                     # (B, 8, S, 128)
        # --- causal attention: softmax(q k^T / sqrt(128)) v ---
        o = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v, is_causal=True)             # (B, 8, S, 128)
        o = o.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, S, D_MODEL)
        # --- output projection + residual ---
        return x + F.linear(o, self.w_o)


def get_inputs():
    g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(SEED + 1)
    x = torch.randn(BATCH, SEQ, D_MODEL, generator=g)
    return [x.to(_device(), DT)]

D_FF = 11008

SEQ = 1024  # BATCH*SEQ = 4096 rows

        y = x + W2 @ gelu(W1 @ rmsnorm(x) * g + b1) + b2
    RMSNorm statistics are computed in fp32, GEMMs run in fp16 with fp32 accumulate.
    """

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        gen = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(20240607)

        def rnd(*shape, std):
            t = torch.randn(*shape, generator=gen, dtype=torch.float32) * std

        self.eps = 1e-6
        self.norm_w = nn.Parameter(1.0 + rnd(D_MODEL, std=0.05), requires_grad=False)
        self.w1 = nn.Parameter(rnd(D_FF, D_MODEL, std=D_MODEL ** -0.5), requires_grad=False)
        self.b1 = nn.Parameter(rnd(D_FF, std=0.02), requires_grad=False)
        self.w2 = nn.Parameter(rnd(D_MODEL, D_FF, std=D_FF ** -0.5), requires_grad=False)
        self.b2 = nn.Parameter(rnd(D_MODEL, std=0.02), requires_grad=False)

import torch.nn.functional as F

DT = torch.float16


class Model(nn.Module):
    """Pre-norm causal MHA block: RMSNorm -> fused QKV GEMM -> RoPE -> causal attention
    -> output projection -> residual.  B=4, H=32, S=2048, D=64 (E=2048), fp16."""

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        dev = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
        self.n_heads, self.head_dim, self.max_seq, self.eps = 32, 64, 2048, 1e-6
        H, D, S = self.n_heads, self.head_dim, self.max_seq
        E = H * D
        g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(1234)
        std = E ** -0.5
        self.w_norm = nn.Parameter((1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(E, generator=g)).to(dev, dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.w_qkv = nn.Parameter((torch.randn(3 * E, E, generator=g) * std).to(dev, dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.w_o = nn.Parameter((torch.randn(E, E, generator=g) * std).to(dev, dt), requires_grad=False)
        half = D // 2
        inv_freq = 1.0 / (10000.0 ** (torch.arange(half, dtype=torch.float32) / half))
        ang = torch.outer(torch.arange(S, dtype=torch.float32), inv_freq)  # [S, D/2]
        self.register_buffer("rope_cos", ang.cos().view(1, S, 1, half).to(dev), persistent=False)
        self.register_buffer("rope_sin", ang.sin().view(1, S, 1, half).to(dev), persistent=False)

    def _rmsnorm(self, x):
        xf = x.float()
        inv = torch.rsqrt(xf.pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True) + self.eps)
        return (xf * inv).to(x.dtype) * self.w_norm

    def _rope(self, t, cos, sin):  # t: [B, S, H, D]
        t1, t2 = t.float().chunk(2, dim=-1)
        return torch.cat((t1 * cos - t2 * sin, t1 * sin + t2 * cos), dim=-1).to(t.dtype)

    def forward(self, x):
        B, S, E = x.shape
        H, D = self.n_heads, self.head_dim
        h = self._rmsnorm(x)
        qkv = F.linear(h, self.w_qkv).view(B, S, 3, H, D)
        q, k, v = qkv.unbind(2)
        cos, sin = self.rope_cos[:, :S], self.rope_sin[:, :S]
        q = self._rope(q, cos, sin).transpose(1, 2)  # [B, H, S, D]
        k = self._rope(k, cos, sin).transpose(1, 2)
        v = v.transpose(1, 2)
        o = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v, is_causal=True, scale=D ** -0.5)
        o = o.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, S, E)
        return x + F.linear(o, self.w_o)


def get_inputs():
    dev = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(0)
    x = torch.randn(4, 2048, 2048, generator=g)
    return [x.to(dev, DT)]

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

DT = torch.float16

# batch * seq = 8 * 1024 = 8192 rows, hidden = 4096
_BATCH, _SEQ, _HIDDEN = 8, 1024, 4096
_DEVICE = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")


class Model(nn.Module):
    """
    Pre-LN transformer sub-block (single fused target):
        y = x + W2 @ gelu_tanh(W1 @ LayerNorm(x) + b1) + b2
    LayerNorm(4096) -> Linear(4096->4096) -> GELU(tanh) -> Linear(4096->4096) -> residual add.
    All parameters are deterministic (fixed-seed generator) and scaled so every
    intermediate stays well inside fp16 range.
    """

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        d = _HIDDEN
        self.eps = 1e-5
        g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(1234)

        ln_w = 1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(d, generator=g)
        ln_b = 0.05 * torch.randn(d, generator=g)
        w1 = torch.randn(d, d, generator=g) * (1.0 / d ** 0.5)
        b1 = 0.02 * torch.randn(d, generator=g)
        w2 = torch.randn(d, d, generator=g) * (1.0 / d ** 0.5)
        b2 = 0.02 * torch.randn(d, generator=g)

        def P(t):
            return nn.Parameter(t.to(device=_DEVICE, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)

        self.ln_w = P(ln_w)
        self.ln_b = P(ln_b)
        self.w1 = P(w1)   # [out, in] layout as in nn.Linear
        self.b1 = P(b1)
        self.w2 = P(w2)
        self.b2 = P(b2)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = F.layer_norm(x, (x.shape[-1],), self.ln_w, self.ln_b, self.eps)
        h = F.linear(h, self.w1, self.b1)
        h = F.gelu(h, approximate="tanh")
        h = F.linear(h, self.w2, self.b2)
        return x + h


def get_inputs():
    g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(4321)
    x = torch.randn(_BATCH, _SEQ, _HIDDEN, generator=g)
    return [x.to(device=_DEVICE, dtype=DT)]

import torch
import torch.nn as nn

DT = torch.float16


class Model(nn.Module):
    # Llama-style pre-norm GQA attention block (inference):
    #   y = x + Wo( CausalGQA( RoPE(Wq h), RoPE(Wk h), Wv h ) ),   h = RMSNorm(x)
    # 8 query heads, 2 KV heads (group size 4), head_dim 128, d_model 1024, seq 2048, batch 4.
    # fp16 GEMMs; RMSNorm, RoPE and softmax evaluated in fp32.
    B, S, D_MODEL, H_Q, H_KV, D_HEAD = 4, 2048, 1024, 8, 2, 128

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        dev = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"
        dm, hq, hkv, dh, S = self.D_MODEL, self.H_Q, self.H_KV, self.D_HEAD, self.S
        self.eps = 1e-5
        self.scale = dh ** -0.5
        g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(1234)

        def w(shape, std):
            return torch.randn(*shape, generator=g, dtype=torch.float32) * std

        self.norm_w = nn.Parameter((1.0 + 0.1 * w((dm,), 1.0)).to(device=dev, dtype=dt))
        # fused QKV projection: [1024, (8 + 2*2) * 128] = [1024, 1536]
        self.w_qkv = nn.Parameter(w((dm, (hq + 2 * hkv) * dh), dm ** -0.5).to(device=dev, dtype=dt))
        self.w_o = nn.Parameter(w((hq * dh, dm), (hq * dh) ** -0.5).to(device=dev, dtype=dt))

        # RoPE tables, computed in float64 then stored as float32 (device independent)
        inv_freq = 1.0 / (10000.0 ** (torch.arange(0, dh, 2, dtype=torch.float64) / dh))
        ang = torch.arange(S, dtype=torch.float64)[:, None] * inv_freq[None, :]
        ang = torch.cat([ang, ang], dim=-1)  # [S, dh]
        self.register_buffer("cos", ang.cos().to(device=dev, dtype=torch.float32), persistent=False)
        self.register_buffer("sin", ang.sin().to(device=dev, dtype=torch.float32), persistent=False)
        self.register_buffer(
            "causal",
            torch.triu(torch.ones(S, S, dtype=torch.bool), diagonal=1).to(dev),
            persistent=False,
        )

    @staticmethod
    def _rot_half(t):
        h = t.shape[-1] // 2
        return torch.cat([-t[..., h:], t[..., :h]], dim=-1)

    def forward(self, x):
        B, S, dm = x.shape
        hq, hkv, dh = self.H_Q, self.H_KV, self.D_HEAD
        dt = self.w_qkv.dtype

        # RMSNorm (fp32)
        xf = x.float()
        h = (xf * torch.rsqrt(xf.pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True) + self.eps)) * self.norm_w.float()
        h = h.to(dt)

        # fused QKV projection
        qkv = h @ self.w_qkv  # [B, S, 1536]
        q, k, v = torch.split(qkv, [hq * dh, hkv * dh, hkv * dh], dim=-1)
        q = q.reshape(B, S, hq, dh)
        k = k.reshape(B, S, hkv, dh)
        v = v.reshape(B, S, hkv, dh)

        # RoPE (fp32); softmax scale folded into q
        cos = self.cos[:S][None, :, None, :]
        sin = self.sin[:S][None, :, None, :]
        qf, kf = q.float(), k.float()
        q = ((qf * cos + self._rot_half(qf) * sin) * self.scale).to(dt)
        k = (kf * cos + self._rot_half(kf) * sin).to(dt)

        # [B, H, S, D]
        q = q.transpose(1, 2)
        k = k.transpose(1, 2)
        v = v.transpose(1, 2)

        # grouped-query: each KV head serves hq // hkv consecutive query heads
        rep = hq // hkv
        k = k.repeat_interleave(rep, dim=1)
        v = v.repeat_interleave(rep, dim=1)

        # causal attention: fp16 matmuls, fp32 masked softmax
        scores = torch.matmul(q, k.transpose(-1, -2)).float()  # [B, H, S, S]
        scores = scores.masked_fill(self.causal[:S, :S], float("-inf"))
        p = torch.softmax(scores, dim=-1).to(dt)
        o = torch.matmul(p, v)  # [B, H, S, D]
        o = o.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, S, hq * dh)

        # output projection + residual
        return x + o @ self.w_o


def get_inputs():
    dev = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"
    g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(4321)
    x = torch.randn(Model.B, Model.S, Model.D_MODEL, generator=g, dtype=torch.float32)
    return [x.to(device=dev, dtype=DT)]

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

DT = torch.float16

ROWS = 4096      # batch * seq
DIM = 4096       # model dim
HIDDEN = 11008   # MLP hidden dim
EPS = 1e-5
SEED = 1234


class Model(nn.Module):
    """
    Pre-norm transformer MLP block (fp16 compute, fp32-stable norm):
        y = x + W2 @ gelu(W1 @ rmsnorm(x) * g + b1) + b2
    """

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        self.dt = dt
        device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
        gen = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(SEED)

        def init(shape, std):
            t = torch.randn(*shape, generator=gen, dtype=torch.float32) * std
            return nn.Parameter(t.to(dtype=dt, device=device), requires_grad=False)

        norm_w = 1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(DIM, generator=gen, dtype=torch.float32)
        self.norm_w = nn.Parameter(norm_w.to(dtype=dt, device=device), requires_grad=False)
        self.w1 = init((HIDDEN, DIM), DIM ** -0.5)     # like nn.Linear(DIM, HIDDEN).weight
        self.b1 = init((HIDDEN,), 0.02)
        self.w2 = init((DIM, HIDDEN), HIDDEN ** -0.5)  # like nn.Linear(HIDDEN, DIM).weight
        self.b2 = init((DIM,), 0.02)

    def forward(self, x):
        # RMSNorm (statistics in fp32), cast back to compute dtype, scale by learned gain
        xf = x.float()
        rstd = torch.rsqrt(xf.pow(2).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + EPS)
        h = (xf * rstd).to(x.dtype) * self.norm_w
        # Two-layer MLP with exact (erf) GELU
        h = F.linear(h, self.w1, self.b1)
        h = F.gelu(h)
        h = F.linear(h, self.w2, self.b2)
        # Residual
        return x + h


def get_inputs():
    device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    gen = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(SEED + 1)
    x = torch.randn(ROWS, DIM, generator=gen, dtype=torch.float32)
    return [x.to(dtype=DT, device=device)]

import torch
import torch.nn as nn

DT = torch.float16
DEVICE = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")

BATCH, SEQ, HEADS, HEAD_DIM = 8, 1024, 16, 64
D_MODEL = HEADS * HEAD_DIM  # 1024


class Model(nn.Module):
    """Pre-norm multi-head self-attention block (no mask, no dropout):
        y = x + (softmax(LN(x)Wq (LN(x)Wk)^T / sqrt(hd)) (LN(x)Wv)) Wo
    LayerNorm statistics and softmax are computed in fp32; GEMMs run in fp16.
    """

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        self.dt = dt
        self.heads = HEADS
        self.head_dim = HEAD_DIM
        self.d_model = D_MODEL
        self.eps = 1e-5
        self.scale = HEAD_DIM ** -0.5

        g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(1234)
        d = D_MODEL
        std = d ** -0.5
        ln_w = 1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(d, generator=g)
        ln_b = 0.1 * torch.randn(d, generator=g)
        w_qkv = torch.randn(d, 3 * d, generator=g) * std
        b_qkv = 0.02 * torch.randn(3 * d, generator=g)
        w_o = torch.randn(d, d, generator=g) * std
        b_o = 0.02 * torch.randn(d, generator=g)

        def mk(t):
            return nn.Parameter(t.to(device=DEVICE, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)

        self.ln_w = mk(ln_w)
        self.ln_b = mk(ln_b)
        self.w_qkv = mk(w_qkv)
        self.b_qkv = mk(b_qkv)
        self.w_o = mk(w_o)
        self.b_o = mk(b_o)

    def forward(self, x):
        B, S, D = x.shape
        H, hd = self.heads, self.head_dim

        # ---- LayerNorm (fp32 statistics) ----
        xf = x.float()
        mu = xf.mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
        var = xf.var(dim=-1, unbiased=False, keepdim=True)
        h = (xf - mu) * torch.rsqrt(var + self.eps)
        h = (h * self.ln_w.float() + self.ln_b.float()).to(x.dtype)

        # ---- Fused QKV projection ----
        qkv = h @ self.w_qkv + self.b_qkv                       # [B, S, 3D]
        q, k, v = qkv.split(D, dim=-1)
        q = q.view(B, S, H, hd).transpose(1, 2)                 # [B, H, S, hd]
        k = k.view(B, S, H, hd).transpose(1, 2)
        v = v.view(B, S, H, hd).transpose(1, 2)

        # ---- Scaled dot-product attention (no mask) ----
        s = torch.matmul(q, k.transpose(-2, -1)) * self.scale   # [B, H, S, S]
        p = torch.softmax(s, dim=-1, dtype=torch.float32).to(x.dtype)
        o = torch.matmul(p, v)                                  # [B, H, S, hd]
        o = o.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, S, D)                  # [B, S, D]

        # ---- Output projection + residual ----
        y = o @ self.w_o + self.b_o
        return x + y


def get_inputs():
    g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(42)
    x = torch.randn(BATCH, SEQ, D_MODEL, generator=g)
    return [x.to(device=DEVICE, dtype=DT)]

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

DT = torch.float16

BATCH = 8
SEQ = 1024
DIM = 2048
HIDDEN = 5632
EPS = 1e-6
SEED = 1234


def _device():
    return torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")


class Model(nn.Module):
    """
    Llama-style pre-norm SwiGLU MLP block with residual:
        h   = RMSNorm(x) * g                     (stats in fp32, eps = 1e-6)
        a   = SiLU(h @ Wg^T) * (h @ Wu^T)        (gate / up projections)
        out = x + a @ Wd^T                       (down projection + residual)
    x: [BATCH, SEQ, DIM] fp16 -> out: [BATCH, SEQ, DIM] fp16
    """

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        self.dt = dt
        self.eps = EPS
        dev = _device()
        gen = torch.Generator().manual_seed(SEED)
        norm_w = 1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(DIM, generator=gen)
        gate_w = torch.randn(HIDDEN, DIM, generator=gen) * (DIM ** -0.5)
        up_w = torch.randn(HIDDEN, DIM, generator=gen) * (DIM ** -0.5)
        down_w = torch.randn(DIM, HIDDEN, generator=gen) * (HIDDEN ** -0.5)
        self.norm_weight = nn.Parameter(norm_w.to(device=dev, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.gate_weight = nn.Parameter(gate_w.to(device=dev, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.up_weight = nn.Parameter(up_w.to(device=dev, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.down_weight = nn.Parameter(down_w.to(device=dev, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)

    def forward(self, x):
        residual = x
        # RMSNorm (fp32 statistics, cast back to activation dtype, then scale)
        h = x.float()
        var = h.pow(2).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
        h = h * torch.rsqrt(var + self.eps)
        h = h.to(x.dtype) * self.norm_weight
        # SwiGLU MLP
        gate = F.linear(h, self.gate_weight)
        up = F.linear(h, self.up_weight)
        act = F.silu(gate) * up
        out = F.linear(act, self.down_weight)
        # residual add
        return residual + out


def get_inputs():
    gen = torch.Generator().manual_seed(SEED + 1)
    scale = 0.5 + 1.5 * torch.rand(BATCH, SEQ, 1, generator=gen)  # per-token rms varies
    x = torch.randn(BATCH, SEQ, DIM, generator=gen) * scale
    return [x.to(device=_device(), dtype=DT)]

import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

DT = torch.float16
_DEV = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")

# batch 4, seq 2048, 32 heads x head_dim 64 -> hidden 2048
B, S, H, DH = 4, 2048, 32, 64
D = H * DH


class Model(nn.Module):
    """Pre-norm causal MHA block:
    RMSNorm -> fused QKV proj -> RoPE(q,k) -> causal SDPA -> out proj -> residual add.
    Deterministic seeded init; all math is fp16 except norm statistics (fp32)."""

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(0x5EED)
        w_qkv = torch.randn(3 * D, D, generator=g) * (D ** -0.5)
        w_qkv[:D] *= 2.0                      # q scale -> attention logits std ~2 (fp16-safe, non-flat softmax)
        w_o = torch.randn(D, D, generator=g) * (1.5 * D ** -0.5)   # residual branch ~ same order as x
        norm_w = 1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(D, generator=g)
        self.w_qkv = nn.Parameter(w_qkv.to(_DEV, dt))
        self.w_o = nn.Parameter(w_o.to(_DEV, dt))
        self.norm_w = nn.Parameter(norm_w.to(_DEV, dt))
        self.eps = 1e-6
        # RoPE tables (computed in fp64, stored in model dtype)
        inv_freq = 1.0 / (10000.0 ** (torch.arange(0, DH, 2, dtype=torch.float64) / DH))
        pos = torch.arange(S, dtype=torch.float64)
        freqs = torch.outer(pos, inv_freq)               # [S, DH/2]
        emb = torch.cat((freqs, freqs), dim=-1)          # [S, DH]
        self.register_buffer("cos", emb.cos().to(_DEV, dt), persistent=False)
        self.register_buffer("sin", emb.sin().to(_DEV, dt), persistent=False)

    @staticmethod
    def _rotate_half(t):
        t1, t2 = t.chunk(2, dim=-1)
        return torch.cat((-t2, t1), dim=-1)

    def forward(self, x):
        Bn, Sn, Dn = x.shape
        # RMSNorm with fp32 statistics, output back in x.dtype
        xf = x.float()
        h = (xf * torch.rsqrt(xf.pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True) + self.eps)).to(x.dtype) * self.norm_w
        # fused QKV projection
        qkv = F.linear(h, self.w_qkv).view(Bn, Sn, 3, H, DH)
        q, k, v = qkv.unbind(2)
        q = q.transpose(1, 2)                            # [B, H, S, DH]
        k = k.transpose(1, 2)
        v = v.transpose(1, 2)
        # rotary position embeddings on q, k
        cos = self.cos[:Sn]
        sin = self.sin[:Sn]
        q = q * cos + self._rotate_half(q) * sin
        k = k * cos + self._rotate_half(k) * sin
        # causal attention (scale = 1/sqrt(DH))
        o = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v, is_causal=True)
        o = o.transpose(1, 2).reshape(Bn, Sn, Dn)
        # output projection + residual
        return x + F.linear(o, self.w_o)


def get_inputs():
    g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(0xBEEF)
    x = torch.randn(B, S, D, generator=g)
    return [x.to(_DEV, DT)]

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

DT = torch.float16

_DEVICE = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")

BATCH = 4
SEQ = 2048
HEAD_DIM = 128
N_Q_HEADS = 8
N_KV_HEADS = 2
D_MODEL = N_Q_HEADS * HEAD_DIM      # 1024
KV_DIM = N_KV_HEADS * HEAD_DIM      # 256
RMS_EPS = 1e-6
ROPE_BASE = 10000.0


class Model(nn.Module):
    # Pre-norm GQA attention sub-block:
    # RMSNorm -> fused QKV proj -> RoPE -> causal grouped-query attention (8 Q / 2 KV heads)
    # -> out proj -> residual add
    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        self.dt = dt
        self.n_q = N_Q_HEADS
        self.n_kv = N_KV_HEADS
        self.groups = N_Q_HEADS // N_KV_HEADS
        self.hd = HEAD_DIM
        self.scale = HEAD_DIM ** -0.5

        g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(20240607)
        std = D_MODEL ** -0.5

        def w(shape, s=std):
            t = torch.randn(shape, generator=g) * s
            return nn.Parameter(t.to(device=_DEVICE, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)

        self.norm_w = nn.Parameter(
            (1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(D_MODEL, generator=g)).to(device=_DEVICE, dtype=dt),
            requires_grad=False,
        )
        self.w_qkv = w((D_MODEL + 2 * KV_DIM, D_MODEL))
        self.w_o = w((D_MODEL, D_MODEL))

        inv_freq = 1.0 / (ROPE_BASE ** (torch.arange(0, HEAD_DIM, 2, dtype=torch.float32) / HEAD_DIM))
        pos = torch.arange(SEQ, dtype=torch.float32)
        freqs = torch.outer(pos, inv_freq)
        emb = torch.cat([freqs, freqs], dim=-1)
        self.register_buffer("rope_cos", emb.cos().to(_DEVICE))
        self.register_buffer("rope_sin", emb.sin().to(_DEVICE))
        self.register_buffer(
            "causal_mask",
            torch.triu(torch.ones(SEQ, SEQ, dtype=torch.bool), diagonal=1).to(_DEVICE),
        )

    @staticmethod
    def _rotate_half(x):
        h = x.shape[-1] // 2
        return torch.cat((-x[..., h:], x[..., :h]), dim=-1)

    def _apply_rope(self, x, cos, sin):
        xf = x.float()
        return (xf * cos + self._rotate_half(xf) * sin).to(x.dtype)

    def forward(self, x):
        bsz, seq, _ = x.shape

        # RMSNorm (fp32 statistics)
        xf = x.float()
        rms = torch.rsqrt(xf.pow(2).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + RMS_EPS)
        xn = (xf * rms).to(x.dtype) * self.norm_w

        # fused QKV projection
        qkv = F.linear(xn, self.w_qkv)
        q, k, v = torch.split(qkv, [D_MODEL, KV_DIM, KV_DIM], dim=-1)
        q = q.view(bsz, seq, self.n_q, self.hd).transpose(1, 2)    # [B, 8, S, 128]
        k = k.view(bsz, seq, self.n_kv, self.hd).transpose(1, 2)   # [B, 2, S, 128]
        v = v.view(bsz, seq, self.n_kv, self.hd).transpose(1, 2)   # [B, 2, S, 128]

        # rotary embeddings
        cos = self.rope_cos[:seq]
        sin = self.rope_sin[:seq]
        q = self._apply_rope(q, cos, sin)
        k = self._apply_rope(k, cos, sin)

        # grouped-query: each KV head serves 4 Q heads
        k = k.repeat_interleave(self.groups, dim=1)                 # [B, 8, S, 128]
        v = v.repeat_interleave(self.groups, dim=1)                 # [B, 8, S, 128]

        # causal attention
        scores = torch.matmul(q * self.scale, k.transpose(-1, -2))  # [B, 8, S, S]
        scores = scores.masked_fill(self.causal_mask[:seq, :seq], torch.finfo(scores.dtype).min)
        attn = torch.softmax(scores, dim=-1, dtype=torch.float32).to(x.dtype)
        ctx = torch.matmul(attn, v)                                  # [B, 8, S, 128]
        ctx = ctx.transpose(1, 2).reshape(bsz, seq, D_MODEL)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn

DT = torch.float16


class Model(nn.Module):
    """Pre-norm multi-head self-attention block (no mask):
        y = x + ( MHSA( LayerNorm(x) @ Wqkv + bqkv ) @ Wo + bo )
    B=8, S=1024, H=16, head_dim=64 (D=1024). All weights are seeded -> deterministic.
    Precision contract: LayerNorm stats + affine in fp32 -> fp16; GEMMs in fp16
    (fp32 accumulate); attention softmax in fp32 -> fp16 probabilities."""

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        dev = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
        self.D, self.H = 1024, 16
        self.hd = self.D // self.H            # 64
        self.eps = 1e-5
        self.scale = self.hd ** -0.5          # 0.125, exactly representable in fp16
        D = self.D
        g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(0)

        def P(t):
            return nn.Parameter(t.to(device=dev, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)

        self.ln_w = P(1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(D, generator=g))
        self.ln_b = P(0.1 * torch.randn(D, generator=g))
        self.w_qkv = P(torch.randn(D, 3 * D, generator=g) * D ** -0.5)   # (D, 3D); columns = [q | k | v]
        self.b_qkv = P(0.02 * torch.randn(3 * D, generator=g))
        self.w_o = P(torch.randn(D, D, generator=g) * D ** -0.5)         # (D, D)
        self.b_o = P(0.02 * torch.randn(D, generator=g))

    def forward(self, x):
        B, S, D = x.shape
        H, hd, dt = self.H, self.hd, x.dtype

        # --- LayerNorm: fp32 statistics + affine, cast to fp16 ---
        xf = x.float()
        mu = xf.mean(-1, keepdim=True)
        var = xf.var(-1, unbiased=False, keepdim=True)
        h = ((xf - mu) * torch.rsqrt(var + self.eps) * self.ln_w.float() + self.ln_b.float()).to(dt)

        # --- fused QKV projection ---
        qkv = torch.addmm(self.b_qkv, h.reshape(B * S, D), self.w_qkv)     # (B*S, 3D)
        q, k, v = qkv.view(B, S, 3, H, hd).permute(2, 0, 3, 1, 4)          # 3 x (B, H, S, hd)

        # --- multi-head scaled dot-product attention, no mask ---
        scores = torch.matmul(q, k.transpose(-2, -1)) * self.scale          # (B, H, S, S) fp16
        p = torch.softmax(scores.float(), dim=-1).to(dt)                    # fp32 softmax -> fp16
        o = torch.matmul(p, v)                                              # (B, H, S, hd)
        o = o.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B * S, D)                             # (B*S, D)

        # --- output projection + residual add ---
        y = torch.addmm(self.b_o, o, self.w_o).view(B, S, D)
        return x + y


def get_inputs():
    dev = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(1234)
    x = torch.randn(8, 1024, 1024, generator=g).to(device=dev, dtype=DT)
    return [x]

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

DT = torch.float16
BATCH, SEQ, DIM, HIDDEN = 8, 1024, 2048, 5632
EPS = 1e-6
DEVICE = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")


class Model(nn.Module):
    """
    Full SwiGLU MLP block (LLaMA-style):
        h   = RMSNorm(x) * norm_weight
        g   = h @ W_gate^T
        u   = h @ W_up^T
        a   = SiLU(g) * u
        out = x + a @ W_down^T
    """

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        self.dt = dt
        self.eps = EPS
        g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(1234)
        norm_w = 1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(DIM, generator=g)
        w_gate = torch.randn(HIDDEN, DIM, generator=g) * (DIM ** -0.5)
        w_up = torch.randn(HIDDEN, DIM, generator=g) * (DIM ** -0.5)
        w_down = torch.randn(DIM, HIDDEN, generator=g) * (HIDDEN ** -0.5)
        self.norm_weight = nn.Parameter(norm_w.to(device=DEVICE, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.w_gate = nn.Parameter(w_gate.to(device=DEVICE, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.w_up = nn.Parameter(w_up.to(device=DEVICE, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.w_down = nn.Parameter(w_down.to(device=DEVICE, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)

    def forward(self, x):
        residual = x
        # RMSNorm computed in fp32 for numerical stability, cast back to fp16
        h = x.float()
        var = h.pow(2).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
        h = h * torch.rsqrt(var + self.eps)
        h = h.to(self.dt) * self.norm_weight
        # Gate / up projections
        gate = F.linear(h, self.w_gate)
        up = F.linear(h, self.w_up)
        # SwiGLU activation
        act = F.silu(gate) * up
        # Down projection + residual
        out = F.linear(act, self.w_down)
        return residual + out


def get_inputs():
    g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(4321)
    x = torch.randn(BATCH, SEQ, DIM, generator=g)
    return [x.to(device=DEVICE, dtype=DT)]

import math
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

DT = torch.float16

B, H, S, D = 4, 32, 2048, 64      # batch, heads, seq, head_dim
E = H * D                          # model dim = 2048
_DEVICE = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"


def _randn(shape, std, seed):
    g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(seed)
    return torch.randn(shape, generator=g, dtype=torch.float32) * std


class Model(nn.Module):
    """
    Pre-norm causal self-attention block (Llama/Qwen-style), single fused target:
        n      = RMSNorm(x)                          (fp32 statistics, fp16 gain)
        q,k,v  = split(n @ Wqkv^T + bqkv)            (fused QKV GEMM, 2048 -> 6144)
        q,k    = RoPE(q), RoPE(k)                    (fp32 rotation, theta=10000)
        a      = softmax(q k^T / sqrt(D) + causal) v (fp32 accumulation)
        y      = x + a @ Wo^T + bo                   (out-proj + residual)
    """

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        self.dt = dt
        self.eps = 1e-5
        dev = _DEVICE
        self.norm_w = nn.Parameter((1.0 + 0.1 * _randn((E,), 1.0, 1)).to(dev, dt))
        self.wqkv = nn.Parameter(_randn((3 * E, E), 1.0 / math.sqrt(E), 2).to(dev, dt))
        self.bqkv = nn.Parameter(_randn((3 * E,), 0.02, 3).to(dev, dt))
        self.wo = nn.Parameter(_randn((E, E), 1.0 / math.sqrt(E), 4).to(dev, dt))
        self.bo = nn.Parameter(_randn((E,), 0.02, 5).to(dev, dt))
        inv_freq = 1.0 / (10000.0 ** (torch.arange(0, D, 2, dtype=torch.float32) / D))
        freqs = torch.outer(torch.arange(S, dtype=torch.float32), inv_freq)   # [S, D/2]
        emb = torch.cat([freqs, freqs], dim=-1)                              # [S, D]
        self.register_buffer("cos", emb.cos().to(dev))
        self.register_buffer("sin", emb.sin().to(dev))

    @staticmethod
    def _rotate_half(t):
        h = t.shape[-1] // 2
        return torch.cat([-t[..., h:], t[..., :h]], dim=-1)

    def _rope(self, t, s):                       # t: [B, H, s, D] fp32
        c = self.cos[:s][None, None]
        sn = self.sin[:s][None, None]
        return t * c + self._rotate_half(t) * sn

    def forward(self, x):
        b, s, e = x.shape
        # RMSNorm (fp32 stats)
        xf = x.float()
        n = xf * torch.rsqrt(xf.pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True) + self.eps)
        n = (n * self.norm_w.float()).to(self.dt)
        # fused QKV projection
        qkv = F.linear(n, self.wqkv, self.bqkv)                          # [B, S, 3E]
        q, k, v = qkv.split(e, dim=-1)
        q = q.view(b, s, H, D).transpose(1, 2)                           # [B, H, S, D]
        k = k.view(b, s, H, D).transpose(1, 2)
        v = v.view(b, s, H, D).transpose(1, 2)
        # rotary embeddings (fp32), back to fp16
        q = self._rope(q.float(), s).to(self.dt)
        k = self._rope(k.float(), s).to(self.dt)
        # causal multi-head attention
        o = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v, is_causal=True)      # [B, H, S, D]
        o = o.transpose(1, 2).reshape(b, s, e)
        # output projection + residual
        return x + F.linear(o, self.wo, self.bo)


def get_inputs():
    g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(1234)
    x = torch.randn(B, S, E, generator=g, dtype=torch.float32)
    return [x.to(_DEVICE, DT)]

import math
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

DT = torch.float16

BATCH = 4
SEQ = 2048
HEAD_DIM = 128
N_Q_HEADS = 8
N_KV_HEADS = 2
HIDDEN = N_Q_HEADS * HEAD_DIM      # 1024
KV_DIM = N_KV_HEADS * HEAD_DIM     # 256
ROPE_THETA = 10000.0
NORM_EPS = 1e-5
SEED = 1234


def _device():
    return torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")


class Model(nn.Module):
    """Pre-norm Llama-style GQA attention block:
    y = x + W_o @ CausalAttn(RoPE(W_q h), RoPE(W_k h), W_v h),  h = RMSNorm(x)
    8 query heads, 2 key/value heads (group size 4), head_dim 128, seq 2048.
    """

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        self.dt = dt
        self.n_q = N_Q_HEADS
        self.n_kv = N_KV_HEADS
        self.groups = N_Q_HEADS // N_KV_HEADS
        self.hd = HEAD_DIM
        self.scale = 1.0 / math.sqrt(HEAD_DIM)
        dev = _device()
        g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(SEED)

        norm_w = 1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(HIDDEN, generator=g)
        w_qkv = torch.randn(HIDDEN + 2 * KV_DIM, HIDDEN, generator=g) * (1.0 / math.sqrt(HIDDEN))
        w_o = torch.randn(HIDDEN, HIDDEN, generator=g) * (1.0 / math.sqrt(HIDDEN))

        self.norm_w = nn.Parameter(norm_w.to(device=dev, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.w_qkv = nn.Parameter(w_qkv.to(device=dev, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)   # [1536, 1024]
        self.w_o = nn.Parameter(w_o.to(device=dev, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)       # [1024, 1024]

        inv_freq = 1.0 / (ROPE_THETA ** (torch.arange(0, HEAD_DIM, 2, dtype=torch.float32) / HEAD_DIM))
        t = torch.arange(SEQ, dtype=torch.float32)
        freqs = torch.outer(t, inv_freq)                 # [S, D/2]
        emb = torch.cat([freqs, freqs], dim=-1)          # [S, D]
        self.register_buffer("cos", emb.cos().to(dev), persistent=False)
        self.register_buffer("sin", emb.sin().to(dev), persistent=False)
        mask = torch.triu(torch.ones(SEQ, SEQ, dtype=torch.bool), diagonal=1)
        self.register_buffer("mask", mask.to(dev), persistent=False)

    @staticmethod
    def _rotate_half(x):
        x1, x2 = x.chunk(2, dim=-1)
        return torch.cat([-x2, x1], dim=-1)

    def _rope(self, x):
        # x: [B, H, S, D]; rotation applied in fp32, result cast back to working dtype
        S = x.shape[-2]
        cos = self.cos[:S].unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(0)
        sin = self.sin[:S].unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(0)
        xf = x.float()
        return (xf * cos + self._rotate_half(xf) * sin).to(x.dtype)

    def forward(self, x):
        B, S, C = x.shape
        dt = x.dtype
        # RMSNorm with fp32 statistics
        xf = x.float()
        h = xf * torch.rsqrt(xf.pow(2).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + NORM_EPS)
        h = (h * self.norm_w.float()).to(dt)
        # fused QKV projection
        qkv = F.linear(h, self.w_qkv)
        q, k, v = torch.split(qkv, [HIDDEN, KV_DIM, KV_DIM], dim=-1)
        q = q.view(B, S, self.n_q, self.hd).transpose(1, 2)    # [B, 8, S, 128]
        k = k.view(B, S, self.n_kv, self.hd).transpose(1, 2)   # [B, 2, S, 128]
        v = v.view(B, S, self.n_kv, self.hd).transpose(1, 2)   # [B, 2, S, 128]
        q = self._rope(q)
        k = self._rope(k)
        # grouped-query: replicate each kv head across its 4 query heads
        k = k.unsqueeze(2).expand(B, self.n_kv, self.groups, S, self.hd).reshape(B, self.n_q, S, self.hd)
        v = v.unsqueeze(2).expand(B, self.n_kv, self.groups, S, self.hd).reshape(B, self.n_q, S, self.hd)
        # causal attention, softmax in fp32
        scores = torch.matmul(q, k.transpose(-1, -2)).float() * self.scale   # [B, 8, S, S]
        scores = scores.masked_fill(self.mask[:S, :S], float("-inf"))
        p = torch.softmax(scores, dim=-1).to(dt)
        attn = torch.matmul(p, v)                                           # [B, 8, S, 128]
        attn = attn.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, S, C)
        # output projection + residual
        return x + F.linear(attn, self.w_o)


def get_inputs():
    g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(SEED + 1)
    x = torch.randn(BATCH, SEQ, HIDDEN, generator=g)
    return [x.to(device=_device(), dtype=DT)]

import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

DT = torch.float16


class Model(nn.Module):
    """Pre-norm multi-head self-attention block (no mask, no dropout, inference):
        h        = LayerNorm(x) * ln_w + ln_b            # eps=1e-5, statistics over last dim
        q, k, v  = split(h @ Wqkv^T + bqkv)              # 16 heads x 64 dims each
        a_h      = softmax(q_h k_h^T / sqrt(64)) v_h     # per head, softmax over keys
        y        = x + (concat_heads(a) @ Wo^T + bo)     # output projection + residual
    x: (8, 1024, 1024) fp16 -> y: (8, 1024, 1024) fp16
    """
    BATCH, SEQ, HEADS, HEAD_DIM = 8, 1024, 16, 64
    D_MODEL = HEADS * HEAD_DIM  # 1024

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        dev = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
        D, H, Dh = self.D_MODEL, self.HEADS, self.HEAD_DIM
        self.n_heads, self.head_dim, self.eps = H, Dh, 1e-5
        g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(0)

        def P(t):  # deterministic CPU init -> target device/dtype, inference-only weights
            return nn.Parameter(t.to(device=dev, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)

        self.ln_w = P(1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(D, generator=g))
        self.ln_b = P(0.1 * torch.randn(D, generator=g))
        self.w_qkv = P(torch.randn(3 * D, D, generator=g) * (2.0 * D ** -0.5))  # rows: [q | k | v]
        self.b_qkv = P(0.02 * torch.randn(3 * D, generator=g))
        self.w_out = P(torch.randn(D, D, generator=g) * D ** -0.5)
        self.b_out = P(0.02 * torch.randn(D, generator=g))

    def forward(self, x):
        B, S, D = x.shape
        H, Dh = self.n_heads, self.head_dim
        h = F.layer_norm(x, (D,), self.ln_w, self.ln_b, self.eps)               # (B, S, D)
        qkv = F.linear(h, self.w_qkv, self.b_qkv).view(B, S, 3, H, Dh)          # (B, S, 3, H, Dh)
        q, k, v = (t.transpose(1, 2) for t in qkv.unbind(2))                    # each (B, H, S, Dh)
        a = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v, attn_mask=None, dropout_p=0.0, is_causal=False)
        a = a.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, S, D)                                  # concat heads
        return x + F.linear(a, self.w_out, self.b_out)                          # residual add


def get_inputs():
    g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(1)
    dev = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    x = torch.randn(Model.BATCH, Model.SEQ, Model.D_MODEL, generator=g)
    return [x.to(device=dev, dtype=DT)]

DT = torch.float16


class Model(nn.Module):

        y = x + W_o * CausalMHA( LayerNorm(x) * W_qkv^T + b_qkv ) + b_o
    B=4, H=32, S=2048, Dh=64  ->  E = H*Dh = 2048.
    """

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        self.B, self.H, self.S, self.Dh = 4, 32, 2048, 64
        self.E = self.H * self.Dh
        self.eps = 1e-5
        E = self.E
        dev = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"
        g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(0)

        def rnd(*shape, scale=1.0):
            return (torch.randn(*shape, generator=g) * scale).to(device=dev, dtype=dt)

        # pre-norm affine
        self.ln_w = nn.Parameter(1.0 + rnd(E, scale=0.1))
        self.ln_b = nn.Parameter(rnd(E, scale=0.1))
        # fused QKV projection (nn.Linear layout: [out, in])
        self.w_qkv = nn.Parameter(rnd(3 * E, E, scale=E ** -0.5))
        self.b_qkv = nn.Parameter(rnd(3 * E, scale=0.01))
        # output projection
        self.w_o = nn.Parameter(rnd(E, E, scale=E ** -0.5))
        self.b_o = nn.Parameter(rnd(E, scale=0.01))

    def forward(self, x):
        B, S, E = x.shape
        H, Dh = self.H, self.Dh
        h = F.layer_norm(x, (E,), self.ln_w, self.ln_b, self.eps)          # [B, S, E]
        qkv = F.linear(h, self.w_qkv, self.b_qkv)                            # [B, S, 3E]
        qkv = qkv.view(B, S, 3, H, Dh).permute(2, 0, 3, 1, 4)                # [3, B, H, S, Dh]

        a = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v, is_causal=True)          # [B, H, S, Dh]
        a = a.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, S, E)                               # [B, S, E]

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

DT = torch.float16

BATCH = 4
SEQ = 2048
D_MODEL = 1024          # 8 heads * 128
N_HEADS = 8
N_KV_HEADS = 2
HEAD_DIM = 128
ROPE_BASE = 10000.0
EPS = 1e-5


class Model(nn.Module):
    """
    Llama-style GQA attention block (pre-RMSNorm -> fused QKV proj -> RoPE ->
    causal grouped-query attention (8 Q heads / 2 KV heads) -> out proj -> residual).
    Reference semantics: fp16 storage, fp16 matmuls (fp32 accumulate),
    RMSNorm / RoPE / softmax computed in fp32.
    """

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        self.dt = dt
        self.dev = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
        self.n_heads = N_HEADS
        self.n_kv_heads = N_KV_HEADS
        self.head_dim = HEAD_DIM
        self.groups = N_HEADS // N_KV_HEADS
        self.q_dim = N_HEADS * HEAD_DIM
        self.kv_dim = N_KV_HEADS * HEAD_DIM
        self.scale = HEAD_DIM ** -0.5
        self.eps = EPS

        g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(1234)
        w_qkv = torch.randn(self.q_dim + 2 * self.kv_dim, D_MODEL, generator=g) * 0.02
        w_o = torch.randn(D_MODEL, self.q_dim, generator=g) * 0.02
        norm_w = 1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(D_MODEL, generator=g)

        self.w_qkv = nn.Parameter(w_qkv.to(device=self.dev, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.w_o = nn.Parameter(w_o.to(device=self.dev, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.norm_w = nn.Parameter(norm_w.to(device=self.dev, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)

        # RoPE tables (fp32) for positions [0, SEQ)
        inv_freq = 1.0 / (ROPE_BASE ** (torch.arange(0, HEAD_DIM, 2, dtype=torch.float32) / HEAD_DIM))
        t = torch.arange(SEQ, dtype=torch.float32)
        freqs = torch.outer(t, inv_freq)               # [S, HD/2]
        emb = torch.cat([freqs, freqs], dim=-1)        # [S, HD]
        self.register_buffer("rope_cos", emb.cos().to(self.dev), persistent=False)
        self.register_buffer("rope_sin", emb.sin().to(self.dev), persistent=False)

        # Causal mask: True == masked
        mask = torch.triu(torch.ones(SEQ, SEQ, dtype=torch.bool), diagonal=1)
        self.register_buffer("causal_mask", mask.to(self.dev), persistent=False)

    @staticmethod
    def _rotate_half(x):
        x1, x2 = x.chunk(2, dim=-1)
        return torch.cat([-x2, x1], dim=-1)

    def _apply_rope(self, x, cos, sin):
        xf = x.float()
        return (xf * cos + self._rotate_half(xf) * sin).to(x.dtype)

    def forward(self, x):
        B, S, D = x.shape
        dt = x.dtype

        # Pre-norm (RMSNorm, fp32 statistics)
        xf = x.float()
        var = xf.pow(2).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
        h = (xf * torch.rsqrt(var + self.eps)).to(dt) * self.norm_w

        # Fused QKV projection
        qkv = F.linear(h, self.w_qkv)
        q, k, v = torch.split(qkv, [self.q_dim, self.kv_dim, self.kv_dim], dim=-1)
        q = q.view(B, S, self.n_heads, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)       # [B, H,   S, HD]
        k = k.view(B, S, self.n_kv_heads, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)    # [B, KVH, S, HD]
        v = v.view(B, S, self.n_kv_heads, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)    # [B, KVH, S, HD]

        # RoPE on Q and K
        cos = self.rope_cos[:S].unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(0)
        sin = self.rope_sin[:S].unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(0)
        q = self._apply_rope(q, cos, sin)
        k = self._apply_rope(k, cos, sin)

        # Grouped-query: expand KV heads to Q heads (Q head i uses KV head i // groups)
        k = k.repeat_interleave(self.groups, dim=1)                          # [B, H, S, HD]
        v = v.repeat_interleave(self.groups, dim=1)                          # [B, H, S, HD]

        # Causal attention: fp16 QK^T (fp32 accumulate), fp32 scale/mask/softmax
        scores = torch.matmul(q, k.transpose(-1, -2)).float() * self.scale   # [B, H, S, S]
        scores = scores.masked_fill(self.causal_mask[:S, :S], float("-inf"))
        probs = torch.softmax(scores, dim=-1).to(dt)
        attn = torch.matmul(probs, v)                                        # [B, H, S, HD]
        attn = attn.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, S, self.q_dim)                # [B, S, H*HD]

        # Output projection + residual
        out = F.linear(attn, self.w_o)
        return x + out


def get_inputs():
    dev = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(42)
    x = torch.randn(BATCH, SEQ, D_MODEL, generator=g)
    return [x.to(device=dev, dtype=DT)]

DT = torch.float16


class Model(nn.Module):
    """
    Pre-norm multi-head self-attention block (bidirectional, no mask, no dropout):
        h   = LayerNorm(x; eps=1e-5) * gamma + beta
        qkv = h @ W_qkv^T + b_qkv                    -> split into Q, K, V   [B, S, 3H]
        A_i = softmax(Q_i K_i^T * head_dim^-0.5) V_i  for each of 16 heads (head_dim 64)
        y   = concat_i(A_i) @ W_o^T + b_o
        out = x + y                                   (residual add, same dtype as x)
    x: [8, 1024, 1024] fp16 (batch 8, seq 1024, hidden 1024 = 16 heads x 64).
    Weights are deterministic (fixed-seed CPU generator), frozen, fp16, on the compute device.
    """

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        self.n_heads = 16
        self.head_dim = 64
        self.hidden = self.n_heads * self.head_dim  # 1024
        self.eps = 1e-5
        self.scale = self.head_dim ** -0.5          # 0.125

        dev = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
        g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(0)
        H = self.hidden

        def mk(t):
            return nn.Parameter(t.to(device=dev, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)

        self.ln_w = mk(1.0 + 0.05 * torch.randn(H, generator=g))
        self.ln_b = mk(0.02 * torch.randn(H, generator=g))
        self.w_qkv = mk(torch.randn(3 * H, H, generator=g) * (H ** -0.5))   # [3H, H]
        self.b_qkv = mk(0.02 * torch.randn(3 * H, generator=g))
        self.w_o = mk(torch.randn(H, H, generator=g) * (H ** -0.5))         # [H, H]
        self.b_o = mk(0.02 * torch.randn(H, generator=g))

    def forward(self, x):
        B, S, H = x.shape
        nh, hd = self.n_heads, self.head_dim

        h = F.layer_norm(x, (H,), self.ln_w, self.ln_b, self.eps)        # [B, S, H]
        qkv = F.linear(h, self.w_qkv, self.b_qkv)                        # [B, S, 3H]
        q, k, v = qkv.split(H, dim=-1)
        q = q.reshape(B, S, nh, hd).transpose(1, 2)                      # [B, nh, S, hd]
        k = k.reshape(B, S, nh, hd).transpose(1, 2)
        v = v.reshape(B, S, nh, hd).transpose(1, 2)

            q, k, v, attn_mask=None, dropout_p=0.0, is_causal=False, scale=self.scale
        )                                                                # [B, nh, S, hd]
        o = o.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, S, H)                           # [B, S, H]
        y = F.linear(o, self.w_o, self.b_o)                              # [B, S, H]

import torch.nn.functional as F

DT = torch.float16


class Model(nn.Module):
    """Llama-style SwiGLU MLP block: y = x + down(silu(gate(rmsnorm(x))) * up(rmsnorm(x)))."""

    def __init__(self, dt=DT, dim=2048, hidden=5632, eps=1e-5, seed=0):
        super().__init__()
        self.eps = eps
        device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
        g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed)
        # Deterministic, well-scaled init (generated on CPU with a fixed seed, then moved to device/dtype).
        norm_w = 1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(dim, generator=g)
        w_gate = torch.randn(hidden, dim, generator=g) * (dim ** -0.5)
        w_up = torch.randn(hidden, dim, generator=g) * (dim ** -0.5)
        w_down = torch.randn(dim, hidden, generator=g) * (hidden ** -0.5)

        self.norm_weight = nn.Parameter(norm_w.to(device=device, dtype=dt))
        self.gate_proj = nn.Linear(dim, hidden, bias=False, device=device, dtype=dt)
        self.up_proj = nn.Linear(dim, hidden, bias=False, device=device, dtype=dt)
        self.down_proj = nn.Linear(hidden, dim, bias=False, device=device, dtype=dt)
        with torch.no_grad():
            self.gate_proj.weight.copy_(w_gate)
            self.up_proj.weight.copy_(w_up)
            self.down_proj.weight.copy_(w_down)
        self.requires_grad_(False)

    def forward(self, x):
        # RMSNorm computed in fp32, cast back to activation dtype.
        h = x.float()
        var = h.pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True)
        h = h * torch.rsqrt(var + self.eps)
        h = (h * self.norm_weight.float()).to(x.dtype)
        # SwiGLU MLP.
        gate = self.gate_proj(h)
        up = self.up_proj(h)
        act = F.silu(gate) * up
        out = self.down_proj(act)
        # Residual add.
        return x + out


def get_inputs():
    device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(1234)
    x = torch.randn(8, 1024, 2048, generator=g).to(device=device, dtype=DT)
    return [x]

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

DT = torch.float16

# Problem shape: batch 4, 32 heads, seq 2048, head_dim 64  ->  model dim 2048
B, H, S, D = 4, 32, 2048, 64
E = H * D
_DEV = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")


class Model(nn.Module):
    """
    Pre-LN causal multi-head self-attention sub-block (single fused target):

        h      = LayerNorm(x)                                   # fp16 in/out, fp32 stats
        qkv    = h @ Wqkv^T + bqkv                              # one (B*S, 2048) x (2048, 6144) GEMM
        q,k,v  = split_heads(qkv)                               # (B, H, S, D)
        q,k    = RoPE(q), RoPE(k)                               # half-split rotary, fp32 math, fp16 out
        o      = softmax_causal(q k^T / sqrt(D)) v              # causal, no NaN rows (diag always unmasked)
        y      = x + merge_heads(o) @ Wo^T + bo                 # out-proj + residual

    Every weight/buffer is created deterministically from fixed seeds, so the
    module is bit-reproducible across instantiations. The forward pass contains
    only deterministic kernels (no atomics / dropout).
    """

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(0)

        def P(t):
            return nn.Parameter(t.to(_DEV, dt), requires_grad=False)

        # LayerNorm affine
        self.ln_w = P(1.0 + 0.05 * torch.randn(E, generator=g))
        self.ln_b = P(0.02 * torch.randn(E, generator=g))
        # Fused QKV projection (3E x E) and output projection (E x E), variance preserving
        self.w_qkv = P(torch.randn(3 * E, E, generator=g) * E ** -0.5)
        self.b_qkv = P(0.02 * torch.randn(3 * E, generator=g))
        self.w_o = P(torch.randn(E, E, generator=g) * E ** -0.5)
        self.b_o = P(0.02 * torch.randn(E, generator=g))
        # Rotary tables kept in fp32 (S, D/2)
        half = D // 2
        inv_freq = 1.0 / (10000.0 ** (torch.arange(half, dtype=torch.float32) / half))
        ang = torch.outer(torch.arange(S, dtype=torch.float32), inv_freq)
        self.register_buffer("cos", ang.cos().to(_DEV), persistent=False)
        self.register_buffer("sin", ang.sin().to(_DEV), persistent=False)
        self.eps = 1e-5

    def _rope(self, t):
        # t: (B, H, S, D) fp16 -> fp16; rotation computed in fp32
        s = t.shape[2]
        c = self.cos[:s]
        sn = self.sin[:s]
        tf = t.float()
        t1, t2 = tf[..., : D // 2], tf[..., D // 2:]
        out = torch.cat((t1 * c - t2 * sn, t1 * sn + t2 * c), dim=-1)
        return out.to(t.dtype)

    def forward(self, x):
        b, s, e = x.shape
        h = F.layer_norm(x, (e,), self.ln_w, self.ln_b, self.eps)
        qkv = F.linear(h, self.w_qkv, self.b_qkv)                       # (B, S, 3E)
        q, k, v = qkv.split(e, dim=-1)
        q = self._rope(q.view(b, s, H, D).transpose(1, 2))              # (B, H, S, D)
        k = self._rope(k.view(b, s, H, D).transpose(1, 2))
        v = v.view(b, s, H, D).transpose(1, 2)
        o = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v, is_causal=True)     # scale = 1/sqrt(D)
        o = o.transpose(1, 2).reshape(b, s, e)
        return x + F.linear(o, self.w_o, self.b_o)


def get_inputs():
    g = torch.Generator(device=_DEV).manual_seed(1)
    x = torch.randn(B, S, E, generator=g, device=_DEV, dtype=torch.float32).to(DT)
    return [x]

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

DT = torch.float16

BATCH = 8
SEQ = 2048
N_Q_HEADS = 8
N_KV_HEADS = 2
HEAD_DIM = 128
HIDDEN = N_Q_HEADS * HEAD_DIM  # 1024
ROPE_THETA = 10000.0
RMS_EPS = 1e-5


class Model(nn.Module):
    # Pre-norm GQA attention sub-block (Llama/Mistral style), causal:
    #   y = x + W_o @ Attn( RoPE(W_q RMSNorm(x)), RoPE(W_k RMSNorm(x)), W_v RMSNorm(x) )
    # 8 query heads, 2 KV heads (query head i uses kv head i // 4), head_dim 128.
    # fp16 storage / GEMMs / attention; fp32 normalization statistics and rotary math.
    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        self.dt = dt
        self.n_q = N_Q_HEADS
        self.n_kv = N_KV_HEADS
        self.d = HEAD_DIM
        self.h = HIDDEN
        self.eps = RMS_EPS
        dev = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")

        g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(20240611)
        std = self.h ** -0.5
        norm_w = 1.0 + 0.05 * torch.randn(self.h, generator=g)
        w_qkv = torch.randn((self.n_q + 2 * self.n_kv) * self.d, self.h, generator=g) * std
        w_o = torch.randn(self.h, self.n_q * self.d, generator=g) * std
        self.norm_w = nn.Parameter(norm_w.to(dev, dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.w_qkv = nn.Parameter(w_qkv.to(dev, dt), requires_grad=False)   # (1536, 1024)
        self.w_o = nn.Parameter(w_o.to(dev, dt), requires_grad=False)       # (1024, 1024)

        inv_freq = 1.0 / (ROPE_THETA ** (torch.arange(0, self.d, 2, dtype=torch.float32) / self.d))
        t = torch.arange(SEQ, dtype=torch.float32)
        freqs = torch.outer(t, inv_freq)                 # (SEQ, D/2)
        emb = torch.cat([freqs, freqs], dim=-1)          # (SEQ, D)
        self.register_buffer("rope_cos", emb.cos().to(dev), persistent=False)
        self.register_buffer("rope_sin", emb.sin().to(dev), persistent=False)

    @staticmethod
    def _rotate_half(x):
        x1, x2 = x.chunk(2, dim=-1)
        return torch.cat([-x2, x1], dim=-1)

    def forward(self, x):
        B, S, H = x.shape
        dt = self.dt

        # RMSNorm (fp32 statistics, fp16 output)
        xf = x.float()
        xn = xf * torch.rsqrt(xf.pow(2).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + self.eps)
        xn = (xn * self.norm_w.float()).to(dt)

        # fused QKV projection
        qkv = F.linear(xn, self.w_qkv)                                      # (B, S, 1536)
        q, k, v = torch.split(qkv, [self.n_q * self.d, self.n_kv * self.d, self.n_kv * self.d], dim=-1)
        q = q.view(B, S, self.n_q, self.d).transpose(1, 2)                  # (B, 8, S, 128)
        k = k.view(B, S, self.n_kv, self.d).transpose(1, 2)                 # (B, 2, S, 128)
        v = v.view(B, S, self.n_kv, self.d).transpose(1, 2)                 # (B, 2, S, 128)

        # rotary position embeddings (fp32 math, fp16 storage)
        cos = self.rope_cos[:S]
        sin = self.rope_sin[:S]
        qf, kf = q.float(), k.float()
        q = (qf * cos + self._rotate_half(qf) * sin).to(dt)
        k = (kf * cos + self._rotate_half(kf) * sin).to(dt)

        # grouped-query attention: expand each kv head to its 4 query heads, causal
        rep = self.n_q // self.n_kv
        k = k[:, :, None].expand(B, self.n_kv, rep, S, self.d).reshape(B, self.n_q, S, self.d)
        v = v[:, :, None].expand(B, self.n_kv, rep, S, self.d).reshape(B, self.n_q, S, self.d)
        o = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v, is_causal=True)         # (B, 8, S, 128)
        o = o.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, S, self.n_q * self.d)              # (B, S, 1024)

        # output projection + residual
        return x + F.linear(o, self.w_o)


def get_inputs():
    g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(1234)
    x = torch.randn(BATCH, SEQ, HIDDEN, generator=g)
    dev = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    return [x.to(dev, DT)]

    Pre-norm transformer MLP sub-block (fp16):
        y = x + W2 @ gelu_tanh(W1 @ rmsnorm(x) * g + b1) + b2
    Fusion targets: rmsnorm -> GEMM1 prologue, bias+gelu -> GEMM1 epilogue,
    bias+residual -> GEMM2 epilogue, no materialized fp16 intermediates.
    """

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        dev = _device()
        g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(20240607)
        norm_w = 1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(DIM, generator=g, dtype=torch.float32)
        w1 = torch.randn(HIDDEN, DIM, generator=g, dtype=torch.float32) * (1.0 / DIM ** 0.5)
        b1 = torch.randn(HIDDEN, generator=g, dtype=torch.float32) * 0.02
        w2 = torch.randn(DIM, HIDDEN, generator=g, dtype=torch.float32) * (1.0 / HIDDEN ** 0.5)
        b2 = torch.randn(DIM, generator=g, dtype=torch.float32) * 0.02
        self.norm_w = nn.Parameter(norm_w.to(dev, dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.w1 = nn.Parameter(w1.to(dev, dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.b1 = nn.Parameter(b1.to(dev, dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.w2 = nn.Parameter(w2.to(dev, dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.b2 = nn.Parameter(b2.to(dev, dt), requires_grad=False)

    def forward(self, x):
        # RMSNorm computed in fp32 for well-defined numerics, cast back to fp16
        xf = x.float()
        inv = torch.rsqrt(xf.pow(2).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + EPS)
        xn = (xf * inv).to(x.dtype) * self.norm_w
        # Two-layer MLP with tanh-approx GELU
        h = F.gelu(F.linear(xn, self.w1, self.b1), approximate="tanh")
        y = F.linear(h, self.w2, self.b2)
        # Residual
        return x + y


def get_inputs():
    g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(0)
    x = torch.randn(BATCH, SEQ, DIM, generator=g, dtype=torch.float32)
    return [x.to(_device(), DT)]

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

DT = torch.float16


class Model(nn.Module):
    """Llama-style SwiGLU MLP block (single fused-able unit):
        h   = RMSNorm(x) * norm_weight
        y   = x + W_down( SiLU(W_gate h) * (W_up h) )
    Shapes: batch 8, seq 1024, dim 2048, hidden 5632.
    """

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        dim, hidden = 2048, 5632
        self.eps = 1e-6
        device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")

        # Deterministic, device-independent init: generate on CPU with a fixed seed.
        g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(1234)
        norm_w = 1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(dim, generator=g)
        w_gate = torch.randn(hidden, dim, generator=g) * (1.0 / dim ** 0.5)
        w_up = torch.randn(hidden, dim, generator=g) * (1.0 / dim ** 0.5)
        w_down = torch.randn(dim, hidden, generator=g) * (1.0 / hidden ** 0.5)

        self.norm_weight = nn.Parameter(norm_w.to(device=device, dtype=dt))
        self.w_gate = nn.Parameter(w_gate.to(device=device, dtype=dt))
        self.w_up = nn.Parameter(w_up.to(device=device, dtype=dt))
        self.w_down = nn.Parameter(w_down.to(device=device, dtype=dt))

    def forward(self, x):
        # RMSNorm with fp32 statistics, cast back to activation dtype, scale by weight
        xf = x.float()
        var = xf.pow(2).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
        h = (xf * torch.rsqrt(var + self.eps)).to(x.dtype) * self.norm_weight
        # Gated MLP
        gate = F.linear(h, self.w_gate)
        up = F.linear(h, self.w_up)
        act = F.silu(gate) * up
        out = F.linear(act, self.w_down)
        # Residual
        return x + out


def get_inputs():
    device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(4321)
    x = torch.randn(8, 1024, 2048, generator=g)
    return [x.to(device=device, dtype=DT)]

import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

DT = torch.float16

# Problem size: batch 4, heads 32, seq 2048, head_dim 64  ->  d_model = 2048
B, H, S, DH = 4, 32, 2048, 64
D = H * DH


class Model(nn.Module):
    """
    Pre-norm causal multi-head self-attention sub-block of a transformer:

        h        = LayerNorm(x) * ln_w + ln_b                      (eps = 1e-5)
        q, k, v  = split(h @ Wqkv^T + bqkv)                        -> [B, H, S, DH] each
        attn     = softmax(q k^T / sqrt(DH) + causal_mask) v       (causal: key j <= query i)
        y        = x + (merge_heads(attn) @ Wo^T + bo)             (residual)

    All weights are fixed by a seeded generator, so the function is fully
    deterministic and numerically well-defined in fp16 (fp32 accumulation
    inside GEMMs / attention as per standard PyTorch semantics).
    """

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        self.dt = dt
        device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
        g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(1234)

        def init(*shape, std):
            t = torch.randn(*shape, generator=g) * std
            return nn.Parameter(t.to(device=device, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)

        # LayerNorm affine params (kept near identity so activations stay O(1))
        self.ln_w = nn.Parameter((1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(D, generator=g)).to(device=device, dtype=dt),
                                 requires_grad=False)
        self.ln_b = nn.Parameter((0.1 * torch.randn(D, generator=g)).to(device=device, dtype=dt),
                                 requires_grad=False)
        # Fused QKV projection: [3D, D], applied as h @ W^T
        self.w_qkv = init(3 * D, D, std=1.0 / math.sqrt(D))
        self.b_qkv = init(3 * D, std=0.02)
        # Output projection: [D, D]
        self.w_o = init(D, D, std=1.0 / math.sqrt(D))
        self.b_o = init(D, std=0.02)

    def forward(self, x):
        Bc, Sc, Dc = x.shape
        # 1) pre-norm
        h = F.layer_norm(x, (Dc,), self.ln_w, self.ln_b, eps=1e-5)
        # 2) fused QKV projection
        qkv = F.linear(h, self.w_qkv, self.b_qkv)                        # [B, S, 3D]
        q, k, v = qkv.split(Dc, dim=-1)
        q = q.view(Bc, Sc, H, DH).transpose(1, 2)                        # [B, H, S, DH]
        k = k.view(Bc, Sc, H, DH).transpose(1, 2)
        v = v.view(Bc, Sc, H, DH).transpose(1, 2)
        # 3) causal scaled-dot-product attention: softmax(q k^T / sqrt(DH), causal) v
        o = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v, is_causal=True)      # [B, H, S, DH]
        # 4) merge heads, output projection, residual
        o = o.transpose(1, 2).reshape(Bc, Sc, Dc)                        # [B, S, D]
        return x + F.linear(o, self.w_o, self.b_o)


def get_inputs():
    device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(4321)
    x = torch.randn(B, S, D, generator=g).to(device=device, dtype=DT)
    return [x]

DT = torch.float16

# batch * seq = 8192 token rows, hidden width 4096

LN_EPS = 1e-5
SEED = 20240611


def _device():
    return torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")


class Model(nn.Module):

    Transformer sub-block to be fused end-to-end (ULTRA tier):

        y = x + ( gelu( LayerNorm(x) @ W1^T + b1 ) @ W2^T + b2 )

    x      : (BATCH, SEQ, HIDDEN) fp16, BATCH*SEQ = 8192 rows
    W1, W2 : (4096, 4096) fp16   -> two 8192x4096x4096 GEMMs (~550 GFLOP)

    All weights come from a fixed-seed generator, so the module is fully
    deterministic. LN affine, both biases, GELU and the residual are all
    numerically active (no stage can be dropped), and every intermediate
    stays O(1) in magnitude so fp16 is well-conditioned throughout.
    """

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        self.dt = dt
        dev = _device()
        H = HIDDEN
        g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(SEED)
        inv_sqrt_h = 1.0 / (H ** 0.5)

        ln_b = 0.05 * torch.randn(H, generator=g)
        w1 = torch.randn(H, H, generator=g) * inv_sqrt_h   # (out, in)
        b1 = 0.02 * torch.randn(H, generator=g)
        w2 = torch.randn(H, H, generator=g) * inv_sqrt_h   # (out, in)
        b2 = 0.02 * torch.randn(H, generator=g)

        def P(t):
            return nn.Parameter(
                t.to(device=dev, dtype=dt).contiguous(), requires_grad=False
            )

        self.ln_weight = P(ln_w)
        self.ln_bias = P(ln_b)
        self.w1 = P(w1)
        self.b1 = P(b1)
        self.w2 = P(w2)
        self.b2 = P(b2)

    def forward(self, x):

        h = F.linear(h, self.w1, self.b1)       # 8192 x 4096 x 4096 GEMM
        h = F.gelu(h, approximate="none")       # exact erf GELU
        h = F.linear(h, self.w2, self.b2)       # 8192 x 4096 x 4096 GEMM
        return x + h                            # residual

    x = torch.randn(BATCH, SEQ, HIDDEN, generator=g)
    return [x.to(device=_device(), dtype=DT).contiguous()]

import torch
import torch.nn as nn

DT = torch.float16


class Model(nn.Module):
    # LLaMA-style pre-norm GQA attention block: RMSNorm -> fused QKV proj -> RoPE ->
    # causal grouped-query attention (8 Q heads, 2 KV heads, head_dim 128) -> out proj -> residual
    B, S, D, NH, NKV, HD = 4, 2048, 1024, 8, 2, 128

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        dev = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
        S, D, NH, NKV, HD = self.S, self.D, self.NH, self.NKV, self.HD
        self.eps = 1e-6
        self.scale = HD ** -0.5
        g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(0)
        w_qkv = torch.randn(NH * HD + 2 * NKV * HD, D, generator=g) * (D ** -0.5)
        w_o = torch.randn(D, NH * HD, generator=g) * (D ** -0.5)
        gamma = 1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(D, generator=g)
        self.w_qkv = nn.Parameter(w_qkv.to(dev, dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.w_o = nn.Parameter(w_o.to(dev, dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.gamma = nn.Parameter(gamma.to(dev, dt), requires_grad=False)
        inv_freq = 1.0 / (10000.0 ** (torch.arange(0, HD, 2, dtype=torch.float32) / HD))
        freqs = torch.outer(torch.arange(S, dtype=torch.float32), inv_freq)
        emb = torch.cat([freqs, freqs], dim=-1)
        self.register_buffer("cos", emb.cos().to(dev), persistent=False)
        self.register_buffer("sin", emb.sin().to(dev), persistent=False)
        self.register_buffer("mask", torch.ones(S, S, dtype=torch.bool).triu(1).to(dev), persistent=False)

    @staticmethod
    def _rope(t, cos, sin):
        tf = t.float()
        h = tf.shape[-1] // 2
        rot = torch.cat([-tf[..., h:], tf[..., :h]], dim=-1)
        return (tf * cos + rot * sin).to(t.dtype)

    def forward(self, x):
        Bx, Sx, Dx = x.shape
        NH, NKV, HD = self.NH, self.NKV, self.HD
        xf = x.float()
        h = (xf * torch.rsqrt(xf.pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True) + self.eps)).to(x.dtype) * self.gamma
        qkv = h @ self.w_qkv.t()
        q, k, v = qkv.split([NH * HD, NKV * HD, NKV * HD], dim=-1)
        q = q.view(Bx, Sx, NH, HD).transpose(1, 2)
        k = k.view(Bx, Sx, NKV, HD).transpose(1, 2)
        v = v.view(Bx, Sx, NKV, HD).transpose(1, 2)
        cos, sin = self.cos[:Sx], self.sin[:Sx]
        q = self._rope(q, cos, sin)
        k = self._rope(k, cos, sin)
        rep = NH // NKV
        k = k.repeat_interleave(rep, dim=1)
        v = v.repeat_interleave(rep, dim=1)
        scores = torch.matmul(q, k.transpose(-1, -2)).float() * self.scale
        scores = scores.masked_fill(self.mask[:Sx, :Sx], float("-inf"))
        p = torch.softmax(scores, dim=-1).to(x.dtype)
        o = torch.matmul(p, v).transpose(1, 2).reshape(Bx, Sx, NH * HD)
        return x + o @ self.w_o.t()


def get_inputs():
    dev = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(1)
    x = torch.randn(Model.B, Model.S, Model.D, generator=g)
    return [x.to(dev, DT)]

import torch.nn.functional as F

DT = torch.float16

DIM = 4096       # model dim
HIDDEN = 11008   # MLP hidden dim
BATCH = 4
SEQ = 1024       # BATCH * SEQ = 4096 rows

_DEVICE = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"


class Model(nn.Module):
    """
    Transformer FFN sub-block (fp16, fp32-accumulated GEMMs):
        y = x + W2 @ gelu(W1 @ x + b1) + b2
    Shapes:
        x  : [BATCH, SEQ, DIM]
        W1 : [HIDDEN, DIM],  b1 : [HIDDEN]
        W2 : [DIM, HIDDEN],  b2 : [DIM]
    Fusion surface: GEMM1 -> (+bias, exact-erf GELU) -> GEMM2 -> (+bias, +residual).
    """

class Model(nn.Module):
    """
    Pre-norm SwiGLU MLP block (LLaMA-style):
        h   = RMSNorm(x) * g
        y   = x + W_down( SiLU(W_gate h) * (W_up h) )
    Shapes: x [B, S, DIM] -> y [B, S, DIM], hidden width HIDDEN.
    """

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        self.dt = dt
        self.eps = EPS
        gen = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(1234)

        # RMSNorm scale: perturbed around 1.0 so it is not a no-op.
        norm_w = 1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(DIM, generator=gen)
        # Variance-scaled projections so fp16 activations remain O(1) end-to-end.
        w_gate = torch.randn(HIDDEN, DIM, generator=gen) * (DIM ** -0.5)
        w_up = torch.randn(HIDDEN, DIM, generator=gen) * (DIM ** -0.5)
        w_down = torch.randn(DIM, HIDDEN, generator=gen) * (HIDDEN ** -0.5)

        self.norm_weight = nn.Parameter(norm_w.to(device=_DEVICE, dtype=dt))
        self.w_gate = nn.Parameter(w_gate.to(device=_DEVICE, dtype=dt))   # [HIDDEN, DIM]
        self.w_up = nn.Parameter(w_up.to(device=_DEVICE, dtype=dt))       # [HIDDEN, DIM]
        self.w_down = nn.Parameter(w_down.to(device=_DEVICE, dtype=dt))   # [DIM, HIDDEN]

    def forward(self, x):
        # ---- RMSNorm (statistics in fp32, output back in activation dtype) ----
        xf = x.float()
        var = xf.pow(2).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
        h = (xf * torch.rsqrt(var + self.eps)).to(x.dtype) * self.norm_weight

        # ---- gate / up projections ----
        gate = F.linear(h, self.w_gate)   # [B, S, HIDDEN]
        up = F.linear(h, self.w_up)       # [B, S, HIDDEN]

        # ---- SwiGLU gating ----
        act = F.silu(gate) * up           # [B, S, HIDDEN]

        # ---- down projection ----
        out = F.linear(act, self.w_down)  # [B, S, DIM]

        # ---- residual ----
        return x + out

    gen = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(4321)
    x = torch.randn(BATCH, SEQ, DIM, generator=gen)
    return [x.to(device=_DEVICE, dtype=DT)]
