import torch.nn.functional as F

DT = torch.float16

BATCH = 8
SEQ = 512            # BATCH * SEQ = 4096 rows
DIM = 4096
HIDDEN = 11008
EPS = 1e-5
DEVICE = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")


class Model(nn.Module):
    """Pre-norm transformer MLP sub-block (forward only, fp16 storage):

        y = x + ( gelu( rmsnorm(x) @ W1^T + b1 ) @ W2^T + b2 )

    Fusion chain: RMSNorm(fp32 stats) -> GEMM1 [4096x4096 @ 4096x11008]
                  -> bias + exact(erf) GELU -> GEMM2 [4096x11008 @ 11008x4096]
                  -> bias + residual add.
    Weights come from a seeded CPU generator (bitwise deterministic) and are
    scaled so every intermediate stays far inside fp16 range.
    """

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(1234)
        norm_w = 1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(DIM, generator=g)
        w1 = torch.randn(HIDDEN, DIM, generator=g) * (2.0 / DIM ** 0.5)
        b1 = 0.02 * torch.randn(HIDDEN, generator=g)
        w2 = torch.randn(DIM, HIDDEN, generator=g) * (1.0 / HIDDEN ** 0.5)
        b2 = 0.02 * torch.randn(DIM, generator=g)
        self.norm_w = nn.Parameter(norm_w.to(DEVICE, dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.w1 = nn.Parameter(w1.to(DEVICE, dt), requires_grad=False)   # [HIDDEN, DIM]
        self.b1 = nn.Parameter(b1.to(DEVICE, dt), requires_grad=False)   # [HIDDEN]
        self.w2 = nn.Parameter(w2.to(DEVICE, dt), requires_grad=False)   # [DIM, HIDDEN]
        self.b2 = nn.Parameter(b2.to(DEVICE, dt), requires_grad=False)   # [DIM]
        self.eps = EPS

    def forward(self, x):
        # x: [BATCH, SEQ, DIM] in DT
        xf = x.float()
        rstd = torch.rsqrt(xf.pow(2).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + self.eps)
        xn = (xf * rstd).to(x.dtype) * self.norm_w              # RMSNorm
        h = F.linear(xn, self.w1, self.b1)                      # [B, S, HIDDEN]
        h = F.gelu(h, approximate="none")                       # exact erf GELU
        y = F.linear(h, self.w2, self.b2)                       # [B, S, DIM]
        return x + y                                            # residual


def get_inputs():
    g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(4321)
    x = torch.randn(BATCH, SEQ, DIM, generator=g)
    return [x.to(DEVICE, DT)]

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

DT = torch.float16

BATCH = 8
HEADS = 16
SEQ = 1024
HEAD_DIM = 64
D_MODEL = HEADS * HEAD_DIM  # 1024
LN_EPS = 1e-5
_DEVICE = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")


class Model(nn.Module):
    """Pre-norm multi-head self-attention block (no mask):
        y = x + ( MHA( LN(x) @ W_qkv^T + b_qkv ) @ W_o^T + b_o )
    LayerNorm statistics/affine computed in fp32 then cast to dt;
    GEMMs and scaled-dot-product attention run in dt (fp16).
    """

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(0)
        std = 1.0 / math.sqrt(D_MODEL)
        w_qkv = torch.randn(3 * D_MODEL, D_MODEL, generator=g) * std
        b_qkv = torch.randn(3 * D_MODEL, generator=g) * 0.02
        w_o = torch.randn(D_MODEL, D_MODEL, generator=g) * std
        b_o = torch.randn(D_MODEL, generator=g) * 0.02
        ln_w = 1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(D_MODEL, generator=g)
        ln_b = 0.1 * torch.randn(D_MODEL, generator=g)

        def P(t):
            return nn.Parameter(t.to(device=_DEVICE, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)

        self.ln_w = P(ln_w)
        self.ln_b = P(ln_b)
        self.w_qkv = P(w_qkv)   # (3*D, D)
        self.b_qkv = P(b_qkv)   # (3*D,)
        self.w_o = P(w_o)       # (D, D)
        self.b_o = P(b_o)       # (D,)

    def forward(self, x):
        B, S, D = x.shape
        # ---- pre-LayerNorm (fp32 math, biased variance, output cast to x.dtype) ----
        xf = x.float()
        mu = xf.mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
        xc = xf - mu
        var = (xc * xc).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
        h = (xc * torch.rsqrt(var + LN_EPS) * self.ln_w.float() + self.ln_b.float()).to(x.dtype)
        # ---- fused QKV projection ----
        qkv = F.linear(h, self.w_qkv, self.b_qkv)                      # (B, S, 3D)
        q, k, v = qkv.split(D, dim=-1)
        q = q.view(B, S, HEADS, HEAD_DIM).transpose(1, 2)              # (B, H, S, Dh)
        k = k.view(B, S, HEADS, HEAD_DIM).transpose(1, 2)
        v = v.view(B, S, HEADS, HEAD_DIM).transpose(1, 2)
        # ---- multi-head scaled dot-product attention, no mask, scale = 1/sqrt(Dh) ----
        o = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v, attn_mask=None, dropout_p=0.0, is_causal=False)
        o = o.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, S, D)                         # (B, S, D)
        # ---- output projection + residual add ----
        y = F.linear(o, self.w_o, self.b_o)
        return x + y


def get_inputs():
    g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(1234)
    x = torch.randn(BATCH, SEQ, D_MODEL, generator=g)
    return [x.to(device=_DEVICE, dtype=DT)]

import torch.nn.functional as F

DT = torch.float16

BATCH = 8
SEQ = 1024
DIM = 2048
HIDDEN = 5632
EPS = 1e-6
SEED = 1234


class Model(nn.Module):
    """
    Llama-style pre-norm SwiGLU MLP block (inference):
        h   = RMSNorm(x) * g
        a   = SiLU(h @ Wg^T) * (h @ Wu^T)
        y   = x + a @ Wd^T
    x: (BATCH, SEQ, DIM) fp16 -> y: (BATCH, SEQ, DIM) fp16
    """

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        dev = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
        gen = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(SEED)

        norm_w = 1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(DIM, generator=gen)
        w_gate = torch.randn(HIDDEN, DIM, generator=gen) * (DIM ** -0.5)
        w_up = torch.randn(HIDDEN, DIM, generator=gen) * (DIM ** -0.5)
        w_down = torch.randn(DIM, HIDDEN, generator=gen) * (HIDDEN ** -0.5)

        self.norm_weight = nn.Parameter(norm_w.to(device=dev, dtype=dt))
        self.w_gate = nn.Parameter(w_gate.to(device=dev, dtype=dt))
        self.w_up = nn.Parameter(w_up.to(device=dev, dtype=dt))
        self.w_down = nn.Parameter(w_down.to(device=dev, dtype=dt))
        self.eps = EPS

    def forward(self, x):
        # RMSNorm computed in fp32 for stability, output cast back to input dtype
        h = x.float()
        var = h.pow(2).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
        h = h * torch.rsqrt(var + self.eps)
        h = h.to(x.dtype) * self.norm_weight

        gate = F.linear(h, self.w_gate)        # (B, S, HIDDEN)
        up = F.linear(h, self.w_up)            # (B, S, HIDDEN)
        act = F.silu(gate) * up                # SwiGLU
        out = F.linear(act, self.w_down)       # (B, S, DIM)
        return x + out                         # residual


def get_inputs():
    dev = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    gen = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(SEED + 1)
    x = torch.randn(BATCH, SEQ, DIM, generator=gen)
    return [x.to(device=dev, dtype=DT)]

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

DT = torch.float16


class Model(nn.Module):
    """Pre-LN causal multi-head attention block (fp16):
    LayerNorm -> fused QKV projection (+bias) -> per-head QK-RMSNorm -> RoPE
    -> causal scaled-dot-product attention -> output projection (+bias) -> residual add.
    """
    B, H, S, HD = 4, 32, 2048, 64
    D = H * HD  # 2048
    ROPE_THETA = 10000.0
    LN_EPS = 1e-5
    RMS_EPS = 1e-6

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        dev = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
        D, HD, S = self.D, self.HD, self.S
        g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(0)

        def p(t):
            return nn.Parameter(t.to(device=dev, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)

        self.ln_w = p(1.0 + 0.05 * torch.randn(D, generator=g))
        self.ln_b = p(0.02 * torch.randn(D, generator=g))
        self.w_qkv = p(0.02 * torch.randn(3 * D, D, generator=g))
        self.b_qkv = p(0.01 * torch.randn(3 * D, generator=g))
        self.q_norm_w = p(1.0 + 0.05 * torch.randn(HD, generator=g))
        self.k_norm_w = p(1.0 + 0.05 * torch.randn(HD, generator=g))
        self.w_o = p(0.02 * torch.randn(D, D, generator=g))
        self.b_o = p(0.01 * torch.randn(D, generator=g))

        inv_freq = 1.0 / (self.ROPE_THETA ** (torch.arange(0, HD, 2, dtype=torch.float32) / HD))
        t = torch.arange(S, dtype=torch.float32)
        freqs = torch.outer(t, inv_freq)            # [S, HD/2]
        emb = torch.cat((freqs, freqs), dim=-1)     # [S, HD]
        self.register_buffer("rope_cos", emb.cos().to(dev), persistent=False)
        self.register_buffer("rope_sin", emb.sin().to(dev), persistent=False)

    @staticmethod
    def _rotate_half(t):
        h = t.shape[-1] // 2
        return torch.cat((-t[..., h:], t[..., :h]), dim=-1)

    def _qk_prep(self, t, w, cos, sin):
        # t: [B, S, H, HD] fp16 -> per-head RMSNorm + RoPE, computed in fp32, cast back once
        tf = t.float()
        tf = tf * torch.rsqrt(tf.square().mean(-1, keepdim=True) + self.RMS_EPS) * w.float()
        tf = tf * cos + self._rotate_half(tf) * sin
        return tf.to(t.dtype)

    def forward(self, x):
        B, S, D = x.shape
        H, HD = self.H, self.HD
        h = F.layer_norm(x, (D,), self.ln_w, self.ln_b, self.LN_EPS)
        qkv = F.linear(h, self.w_qkv, self.b_qkv).view(B, S, 3, H, HD)
        q, k, v = qkv.unbind(2)                                       # [B, S, H, HD]
        cos = self.rope_cos[:S].view(1, S, 1, HD)
        sin = self.rope_sin[:S].view(1, S, 1, HD)
        q = self._qk_prep(q, self.q_norm_w, cos, sin).transpose(1, 2)  # [B, H, S, HD]
        k = self._qk_prep(k, self.k_norm_w, cos, sin).transpose(1, 2)
        v = v.transpose(1, 2)
        o = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v, is_causal=True, scale=1.0 / math.sqrt(HD))
        o = o.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, S, D)
        return x + F.linear(o, self.w_o, self.b_o)


def get_inputs():
    dev = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(1234)
    x = torch.randn(Model.B, Model.S, Model.D, generator=g)
    return [x.to(device=dev, dtype=DT)]

_KVD = _KVH * _HD                # kv dim = 256
_EPS = 1e-6
_THETA = 10000.0
_DEV = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")


class Model(nn.Module):
    # Llama-style GQA attention block:
    # RMSNorm -> fused QKV proj -> RoPE -> causal grouped-query SDPA -> out proj -> residual
    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        self.dt = dt
        g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(1234)
        w_qkv = torch.randn(_D + 2 * _KVD, _D, generator=g) * (_D ** -0.5)
        w_o = torch.randn(_D, _D, generator=g) * (_D ** -0.5)
        w_norm = 1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(_D, generator=g)
        self.w_qkv = nn.Parameter(w_qkv.to(device=_DEV, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.w_o = nn.Parameter(w_o.to(device=_DEV, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.w_norm = nn.Parameter(w_norm.to(device=_DEV, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        inv_freq = 1.0 / (_THETA ** (torch.arange(0, _HD, 2, dtype=torch.float32) / _HD))
        freqs = torch.outer(torch.arange(_S, dtype=torch.float32), inv_freq)  # (S, HD/2)
        self.register_buffer("cos", freqs.cos().to(_DEV), persistent=False)
        self.register_buffer("sin", freqs.sin().to(_DEV), persistent=False)

    def _rope(self, t):
        # t: (B, nH, S, HD); rotate pairs (i, i + HD/2) in fp32
        S = t.shape[2]
        tf = t.float()
        t1, t2 = tf[..., : _HD // 2], tf[..., _HD // 2:]
        c = self.cos[:S][None, None]
        s = self.sin[:S][None, None]
        return torch.cat((t1 * c - t2 * s, t1 * s + t2 * c), dim=-1).to(t.dtype)

    def forward(self, x):
        B, S, D = x.shape
        # pre-norm RMSNorm with fp32 statistics
        xf = x.float()
        h = xf * torch.rsqrt(xf.pow(2).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + _EPS)
        h = (h * self.w_norm.float()).to(x.dtype)
        # fused QKV projection
        qkv = F.linear(h, self.w_qkv)                                   # (B, S, D + 2*KVD)
        q, k, v = torch.split(qkv, [_D, _KVD, _KVD], dim=-1)
        q = q.view(B, S, _H, _HD).transpose(1, 2)                       # (B, H, S, HD)
        k = k.view(B, S, _KVH, _HD).transpose(1, 2)                     # (B, KVH, S, HD)
        v = v.view(B, S, _KVH, _HD).transpose(1, 2)                     # (B, KVH, S, HD)
        q = self._rope(q)
        k = self._rope(k)
        # grouped-query attention: q head h attends kv head h // G
        G = _H // _KVH
        k = k[:, :, None].expand(B, _KVH, G, S, _HD).reshape(B, _H, S, _HD)
        v = v[:, :, None].expand(B, _KVH, G, S, _HD).reshape(B, _H, S, _HD)
        o = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v, is_causal=True)    # (B, H, S, HD)
        o = o.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, S, D)
        # output projection + residual
        return x + F.linear(o, self.w_o)


def get_inputs():
    g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(4321)
    x = torch.randn(_B, _S, _D, generator=g)
    return [x.to(device=_DEV, dtype=DT)]

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

DT = torch.float16

# Problem size: pre-norm multi-head self-attention block, d_model = heads * head_dim = 1024
BATCH, SEQ, HEADS, HEAD_DIM = 8, 1024, 16, 64
D_MODEL = HEADS * HEAD_DIM
LN_EPS = 1e-5
SEED = 20240611


def _device():
    return torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")


class Model(nn.Module):
    """
    y = x + W_o( MHA( LayerNorm(x) ) ) + b_o

    LayerNorm (affine) -> fused QKV projection (+bias) -> split into 16 heads of dim 64
    -> softmax(q k^T / sqrt(64)) v  (no mask, no dropout) -> merge heads
    -> output projection (+bias) -> residual add.
    x: [B, S, D] fp16  ->  [B, S, D] fp16
    """

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        self.heads, self.head_dim, self.d_model, self.eps = HEADS, HEAD_DIM, D_MODEL, LN_EPS
        D = D_MODEL
        dev = _device()
        g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(SEED)

        def rnd(*shape, std):
            return torch.randn(*shape, generator=g, dtype=torch.float32) * std

        def param(t):
            return nn.Parameter(t.to(device=dev, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)

        # Scales chosen so attention logits have std ~1.2 (non-trivial softmax) and the
        # attention branch contributes O(0.4) std to the residual stream (well-conditioned check).
        self.ln_w = param(1.0 + rnd(D, std=0.05))
        self.ln_b = param(rnd(D, std=0.05))
        self.qkv_w = param(rnd(3 * D, D, std=0.035))
        self.qkv_b = param(rnd(3 * D, std=0.02))
        self.proj_w = param(rnd(D, D, std=0.15))
        self.proj_b = param(rnd(D, std=0.02))

    def forward(self, x):
        B, S, D = x.shape
        H, hd = self.heads, self.head_dim
        h = F.layer_norm(x, (D,), self.ln_w, self.ln_b, self.eps)            # pre-norm
        qkv = F.linear(h, self.qkv_w, self.qkv_b)                              # [B, S, 3D]
        q, k, v = qkv.split(D, dim=-1)
        q = q.reshape(B, S, H, hd).transpose(1, 2)                             # [B, H, S, hd]
        k = k.reshape(B, S, H, hd).transpose(1, 2)
        v = v.reshape(B, S, H, hd).transpose(1, 2)
        o = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(
            q, k, v, attn_mask=None, dropout_p=0.0, is_causal=False
        )                                                                      # softmax(qk^T/8) v
        o = o.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, S, D)                                 # merge heads
        return x + F.linear(o, self.proj_w, self.proj_b)                       # out-proj + residual


def get_inputs():
    g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(SEED + 1)
    x = torch.randn(BATCH, SEQ, D_MODEL, generator=g, dtype=torch.float32)
    return [x.to(device=_device(), dtype=DT)]

import torch
import torch.nn as nn

DT = torch.float16


class Model(nn.Module):
    """
    Llama-style SwiGLU MLP transformer sub-block (fp16, Batch 8 x Seq 1024 x Dim 2048, Hidden 5632):
        h = RMSNorm(x) * w_norm            (stats in fp32, cast back to fp16 before the scale)
        g = h @ W_gate^T                    [2048 -> 5632]
        u = h @ W_up^T                      [2048 -> 5632]
        a = SiLU(g) * u
        y = x + a @ W_down^T                [5632 -> 2048] + residual
    ~566 GFLOP per forward. Weights are deterministic (fixed-seed CPU generator) and scaled so all
    intermediates stay O(1), well inside fp16 range.
    """
    BATCH = 8
    SEQ = 1024
    DIM = 2048
    HIDDEN = 5632
    EPS = 1e-5

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
        gen = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(1234)
        D, H = self.DIM, self.HIDDEN

        w_norm = 1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(D, generator=gen)              # RMSNorm scale, near 1
        w_gate = torch.randn(H, D, generator=gen) * (D ** -0.5)         # [hidden, dim]
        w_up = torch.randn(H, D, generator=gen) * (D ** -0.5)           # [hidden, dim]
        w_down = torch.randn(D, H, generator=gen) * (H ** -0.5)         # [dim, hidden]

        self.norm_weight = nn.Parameter(w_norm.to(device=device, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.gate_weight = nn.Parameter(w_gate.to(device=device, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.up_weight = nn.Parameter(w_up.to(device=device, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.down_weight = nn.Parameter(w_down.to(device=device, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.eps = self.EPS

    def forward(self, x):
        # x: [B, S, D] fp16
        xf = x.float()
        inv_rms = torch.rsqrt(xf.pow(2).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + self.eps)
        h = (xf * inv_rms).to(x.dtype) * self.norm_weight
        g = nn.functional.linear(h, self.gate_weight)
        u = nn.functional.linear(h, self.up_weight)
        a = nn.functional.silu(g) * u
        return x + nn.functional.linear(a, self.down_weight)


def get_inputs():
    device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    gen = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(4321)
    x = torch.randn(Model.BATCH, Model.SEQ, Model.DIM, generator=gen)
    return [x.to(device=device, dtype=DT)]

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

DT = torch.float16


class Model(nn.Module):
    # Pre-LN causal multi-head attention block (fp16 I/O):
    #   [q|k|v] = W_qkv @ LN(x) + b_qkv
    #   y = x + W_o @ SDPA_causal(RoPE(q), RoPE(k), v) + b_o
    # B=4, S=2048, H=32, head_dim=64  ->  D = 2048
    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        self.dt = dt
        self.H, self.DH, self.S_max = 32, 64, 2048
        self.D = self.H * self.DH
        self.eps = 1e-5
        D, DH, S = self.D, self.DH, self.S_max
        dev = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
        g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(0)

        def rnd(*shape, std=1.0):
            return torch.randn(*shape, generator=g) * std

        def P(t):
            return nn.Parameter(t.to(device=dev, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)

        # LayerNorm affine
        self.ln_w = P(1.0 + rnd(D, std=0.1))
        self.ln_b = P(rnd(D, std=0.05))
        # fused QKV projection (rows: [Q heads | K heads | V heads])
        self.w_qkv = P(rnd(3 * D, D, std=D ** -0.5))
        self.b_qkv = P(rnd(3 * D, std=0.02))
        # output projection
        self.w_o = P(rnd(D, D, std=D ** -0.5))
        self.b_o = P(rnd(D, std=0.02))
        # RoPE tables (fp32, rotate-half convention, base 10000)
        inv_freq = 1.0 / (10000.0 ** (torch.arange(0, DH, 2, dtype=torch.float32) / DH))
        freqs = torch.outer(torch.arange(S, dtype=torch.float32), inv_freq)  # (S, DH/2)
        emb = torch.cat((freqs, freqs), dim=-1)                               # (S, DH)
        self.register_buffer("cos", emb.cos().to(dev), persistent=False)
        self.register_buffer("sin", emb.sin().to(dev), persistent=False)

    @staticmethod
    def _rope(t, cos, sin):
        # t: (B, H, S, DH) -> fp32 math, rotate-half
        t = t.float()
        t1, t2 = t.chunk(2, dim=-1)
        rot = torch.cat((-t2, t1), dim=-1)
        return t * cos + rot * sin

    def forward(self, x):
        B, S, D = x.shape
        dt = x.dtype
        # 1) pre-LayerNorm with fp32 statistics, back to fp16
        h = F.layer_norm(x.float(), (D,), self.ln_w.float(), self.ln_b.float(), self.eps).to(dt)
        # 2) fused QKV projection -> split heads
        qkv = F.linear(h, self.w_qkv, self.b_qkv)                          # (B, S, 3D)
        q, k, v = qkv.view(B, S, 3, self.H, self.DH).unbind(dim=2)          # (B, S, H, DH) x3
        q, k, v = q.transpose(1, 2), k.transpose(1, 2), v.transpose(1, 2)  # (B, H, S, DH)
        # 3) rotary position embedding on q, k
        cos, sin = self.cos[:S], self.sin[:S]
        q = self._rope(q, cos, sin).to(dt)
        k = self._rope(k, cos, sin).to(dt)
        # 4) causal softmax attention, scale = 1/sqrt(DH) (default)
        o = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v, is_causal=True)         # (B, H, S, DH)
        # 5) merge heads, output projection, residual
        o = o.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, S, D)
        y = F.linear(o, self.w_o, self.b_o)
        return x + y


def get_inputs():
    dev = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(1234)
    x = torch.randn(4, 2048, 2048, generator=g).to(device=dev, dtype=DT)
    return [x]

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

DT = torch.float16

BATCH = 8          # batch * seq = 8192 rows
SEQ = 1024
HIDDEN = 4096      # d_model == mlp width (4096 -> 4096 -> 4096)
EPS = 1e-5
SEED = 1234


class Model(nn.Module):
    """
    Pre-LN transformer MLP sub-block (fp16 storage, exact erf-GELU):
        y = x + ( gelu( LN(x) @ W1^T + b1 ) @ W2^T + b2 )
    Shapes: x [8, 1024, 4096]; W1, W2 [4096, 4096].
    All parameters are drawn deterministically from a fixed seed so
    results are reproducible across runs.
    """

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        dev = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
        H = HIDDEN
        g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(SEED)
        ln_w = 1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(H, generator=g)            # non-trivial LN affine
        ln_b = 0.1 * torch.randn(H, generator=g)
        w1 = torch.randn(H, H, generator=g) * (1.0 / math.sqrt(H))  # unit-variance activations
        b1 = 0.1 * torch.randn(H, generator=g)
        w2 = torch.randn(H, H, generator=g) * (1.0 / math.sqrt(H))
        b2 = 0.1 * torch.randn(H, generator=g)

        def P(t):
            return nn.Parameter(t.to(device=dev, dtype=dt).contiguous(), requires_grad=False)

        self.ln_w = P(ln_w)
        self.ln_b = P(ln_b)
        self.w1 = P(w1)    # [out=4096, in=4096], F.linear convention: y = x @ W^T + b
        self.b1 = P(b1)
        self.w2 = P(w2)
        self.b2 = P(b2)
        self.normalized_shape = (H,)
        self.eps = EPS

    def forward(self, x):
        h = F.layer_norm(x, self.normalized_shape, self.ln_w, self.ln_b, self.eps)
        h = F.linear(h, self.w1, self.b1)
        h = F.gelu(h)                       # exact (erf) GELU
        h = F.linear(h, self.w2, self.b2)
        return x + h                        # residual connection


def get_inputs():
    dev = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(SEED + 1)
    x = torch.randn(BATCH, SEQ, HIDDEN, generator=g)
    # per-token scale/shift so LayerNorm is numerically non-trivial (cannot be skipped)
    scale = torch.empty(BATCH, SEQ, 1).uniform_(0.5, 2.0, generator=g)
    shift = torch.empty(BATCH, SEQ, 1).uniform_(-1.0, 1.0, generator=g)
    x = x * scale + shift
    return [x.to(device=dev, dtype=DT).contiguous()]

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

DT = torch.float16

BATCH = 8
SEQ = 2048
HEAD_DIM = 128
N_Q_HEADS = 8
N_KV_HEADS = 2
HIDDEN = N_Q_HEADS * HEAD_DIM          # 1024
KV_DIM = N_KV_HEADS * HEAD_DIM         # 256
ROPE_THETA = 10000.0
EPS = 1e-5
SEED = 1234


def _device():
    return torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")


class Model(nn.Module):
    """Llama-style GQA attention block:
    RMSNorm -> fused QKV proj -> RoPE -> causal grouped-query attention (8 Q heads / 2 KV heads)
    -> output proj -> residual add.
    """

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        self.dt = dt
        dev = _device()
        g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(SEED)
        std = HIDDEN ** -0.5
        w_qkv = torch.randn(HIDDEN + 2 * KV_DIM, HIDDEN, generator=g) * std   # [1536, 1024]
        w_o = torch.randn(HIDDEN, HIDDEN, generator=g) * std                  # [1024, 1024]
        norm_w = 1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(HIDDEN, generator=g)                 # [1024]
        self.w_qkv = nn.Parameter(w_qkv.to(device=dev, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.w_o = nn.Parameter(w_o.to(device=dev, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.norm_w = nn.Parameter(norm_w.to(device=dev, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        # RoPE tables kept in fp32 for a well-defined rotation
        inv_freq = 1.0 / (ROPE_THETA ** (torch.arange(0, HEAD_DIM, 2, dtype=torch.float32) / HEAD_DIM))
        freqs = torch.outer(torch.arange(SEQ, dtype=torch.float32), inv_freq)  # [SEQ, 64]
        emb = torch.cat([freqs, freqs], dim=-1)                                # [SEQ, 128]
        self.register_buffer("rope_cos", emb.cos().to(dev), persistent=False)
        self.register_buffer("rope_sin", emb.sin().to(dev), persistent=False)

    @staticmethod
    def _rotate_half(t):
        d = t.shape[-1] // 2
        return torch.cat([-t[..., d:], t[..., :d]], dim=-1)

    def forward(self, x):
        B, S, _ = x.shape
        # RMSNorm with fp32 statistics
        xf = x.float()
        h = (xf * torch.rsqrt(xf.pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True) + EPS)).to(self.dt) * self.norm_w
        # fused QKV projection
        qkv = F.linear(h, self.w_qkv)
        q, k, v = torch.split(qkv, [HIDDEN, KV_DIM, KV_DIM], dim=-1)
        q = q.view(B, S, N_Q_HEADS, HEAD_DIM).transpose(1, 2)    # [B, 8, S, 128]
        k = k.view(B, S, N_KV_HEADS, HEAD_DIM).transpose(1, 2)   # [B, 2, S, 128]
        v = v.view(B, S, N_KV_HEADS, HEAD_DIM).transpose(1, 2)   # [B, 2, S, 128]
        # RoPE on q and k (fp32 math, cast back)
        cos, sin = self.rope_cos[:S], self.rope_sin[:S]
        qf, kf = q.float(), k.float()
        q = (qf * cos + self._rotate_half(qf) * sin).to(self.dt)
        k = (kf * cos + self._rotate_half(kf) * sin).to(self.dt)
        # grouped-query: each KV head serves 4 consecutive Q heads
        rep = N_Q_HEADS // N_KV_HEADS
        k = k.repeat_interleave(rep, dim=1)                      # [B, 8, S, 128]
        v = v.repeat_interleave(rep, dim=1)                      # [B, 8, S, 128]
        # causal attention, scale = 1/sqrt(128)
        attn = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v, is_causal=True)  # [B, 8, S, 128]
        attn = attn.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, S, HIDDEN)
        # output projection + residual
        return x + F.linear(attn, self.w_o)


def get_inputs():
    g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(SEED + 1)
    x = torch.randn(BATCH, SEQ, HIDDEN, generator=g)
    return [x.to(device=_device(), dtype=DT)]

class Model(nn.Module):
    # Pre-norm transformer MLP sub-block:  out = x + W2 @ gelu_tanh( W1 @ rmsnorm(x) )
    # Fusion surface: RMSNorm -> GEMM1 (4096->11008) -> GELU epilogue -> GEMM2 (11008->4096) -> residual epilogue

    EPS = 1e-6

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):

        device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
        g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(1234)
        norm_w = 1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(self.DIM, generator=g)
        w1 = torch.randn(self.HIDDEN, self.DIM, generator=g) * (1.0 / self.DIM ** 0.5)
        w2 = torch.randn(self.DIM, self.HIDDEN, generator=g) * (1.0 / self.HIDDEN ** 0.5)
        self.norm_w = nn.Parameter(norm_w.to(device=device, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.w1 = nn.Parameter(w1.to(device=device, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.w2 = nn.Parameter(w2.to(device=device, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)

        g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(1234)

        self.w_o = prm(rnd(D, D) * D ** -0.5)               # (D, D)
        self.b_o = prm(0.02 * rnd(D))

import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

DT = torch.float16


class Model(nn.Module):
    # Pre-norm causal MHA block: RMSNorm -> fused QKV proj -> per-head QK-RMSNorm -> RoPE
    # -> causal SDPA (B=4, H=32, S=2048, Dh=64) -> output proj -> residual add.
    B, S, H, DH = 4, 2048, 32, 64
    D = H * DH
    EPS = 1e-6
    THETA = 10000.0

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        dev = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
        self.dt = dt
        D, DH, S = self.D, self.DH, self.S
        self.scale = DH ** -0.5
        g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(0)

        def P(t):
            return nn.Parameter(t.to(device=dev, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)

        self.ln_w = P(1.0 + 0.05 * torch.randn(D, generator=g))
        self.w_qkv = P(torch.randn(3 * D, D, generator=g) * D ** -0.5)
        self.q_w = P(2.0 + 0.10 * torch.randn(DH, generator=g))
        self.k_w = P(1.0 + 0.10 * torch.randn(DH, generator=g))
        self.w_o = P(torch.randn(D, D, generator=g) * D ** -0.5)

        inv_freq = 1.0 / (self.THETA ** (torch.arange(0, DH, 2, dtype=torch.float32) / DH))
        freqs = torch.outer(torch.arange(S, dtype=torch.float32), inv_freq)
        emb = torch.cat((freqs, freqs), dim=-1)  # [S, DH]
        self.register_buffer("cos", emb.cos().to(dev), persistent=False)
        self.register_buffer("sin", emb.sin().to(dev), persistent=False)

    def _rmsnorm(self, t, w):
        tf = t.float()
        tf = tf * torch.rsqrt(tf.pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True) + self.EPS)
        return tf * w.float()

    def _qk_prep(self, t, w, cos, sin):
        tf = self._rmsnorm(t, w)  # [B, S, H, DH] fp32
        half = self.DH // 2
        rot = torch.cat((-tf[..., half:], tf[..., :half]), dim=-1)
        out = tf * cos[None, :, None, :] + rot * sin[None, :, None, :]
        return out.to(t.dtype)

    def forward(self, x):
        bsz, seq, dim = x.shape
        H, DH = self.H, self.DH
        hn = self._rmsnorm(x, self.ln_w).to(x.dtype)
        qkv = F.linear(hn, self.w_qkv)
        q, k, v = qkv.split(dim, dim=-1)
        q = q.view(bsz, seq, H, DH)
        k = k.view(bsz, seq, H, DH)
        v = v.view(bsz, seq, H, DH)
        cos, sin = self.cos[:seq], self.sin[:seq]
        q = self._qk_prep(q, self.q_w, cos, sin).transpose(1, 2)
        k = self._qk_prep(k, self.k_w, cos, sin).transpose(1, 2)
        v = v.transpose(1, 2)
        o = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v, is_causal=True, scale=self.scale)
        o = o.transpose(1, 2).reshape(bsz, seq, dim)
        return x + F.linear(o, self.w_o)


def get_inputs():
    dev = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(1234)
    x = torch.randn(Model.B, Model.S, Model.D, generator=g)
    return [x.to(device=dev, dtype=DT)]

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

DT = torch.float16

# ---------------- problem size (Llama/Mistral-style decoder attention block) ----------------
BATCH = 8
SEQ = 2048
N_Q_HEADS = 8
N_KV_HEADS = 2
HEAD_DIM = 128
HIDDEN = N_Q_HEADS * HEAD_DIM      # 1024
KV_DIM = N_KV_HEADS * HEAD_DIM     # 256
ROPE_THETA = 10000.0
EPS = 1e-5
_DEVICE = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"


def _rotate_half(t):
    d = t.shape[-1] // 2
    return torch.cat((-t[..., d:], t[..., :d]), dim=-1)


class Model(nn.Module):
    """
    Pre-norm grouped-query attention block, fp16 storage:
        h   = RMSNorm(x) * g                         (fp32 statistics)
        qkv = h @ Wqkv^T                             (fused: 8 Q heads + 2 K heads + 2 V heads, head_dim 128)
        q,k = RoPE(q), RoPE(k)                       (fp32 math, fp16 storage)
        a   = causal_softmax(q k^T / sqrt(128)) v    (each KV head shared by 4 Q heads)
        y   = x + a @ Wo^T                           (residual)
    Deterministic: fixed-seed weights, no dropout, no atomics.
    """

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        self.dt = dt
        self.n_q = N_Q_HEADS
        self.n_kv = N_KV_HEADS
        self.n_rep = N_Q_HEADS // N_KV_HEADS
        self.hd = HEAD_DIM
        self.eps = EPS

        g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(1234)
        w_qkv = torch.randn(HIDDEN + 2 * KV_DIM, HIDDEN, generator=g) * (HIDDEN ** -0.5)
        w_o = torch.randn(HIDDEN, HIDDEN, generator=g) * (HIDDEN ** -0.5)
        norm_w = 1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(HIDDEN, generator=g)

        self.norm_weight = nn.Parameter(norm_w.to(device=_DEVICE, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.w_qkv = nn.Parameter(w_qkv.to(device=_DEVICE, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.w_o = nn.Parameter(w_o.to(device=_DEVICE, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)

        inv_freq = 1.0 / (ROPE_THETA ** (torch.arange(0, HEAD_DIM, 2, dtype=torch.float32) / HEAD_DIM))
        pos = torch.arange(SEQ, dtype=torch.float32)
        freqs = torch.outer(pos, inv_freq)            # [S, hd/2]
        emb = torch.cat((freqs, freqs), dim=-1)       # [S, hd]
        self.register_buffer("rope_cos", emb.cos().to(_DEVICE), persistent=False)
        self.register_buffer("rope_sin", emb.sin().to(_DEVICE), persistent=False)

    def forward(self, x):
        B, S, H = x.shape
        residual = x

        # RMSNorm with fp32 statistics
        xf = x.float()
        h = xf * torch.rsqrt(xf.pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True) + self.eps)
        h = h.to(self.dt) * self.norm_weight

        # fused QKV projection
        qkv = F.linear(h, self.w_qkv)                                  # [B, S, 1536]
        q, k, v = qkv.split([HIDDEN, KV_DIM, KV_DIM], dim=-1)
        q = q.view(B, S, self.n_q, self.hd).transpose(1, 2)            # [B, 8, S, 128]
        k = k.view(B, S, self.n_kv, self.hd).transpose(1, 2)           # [B, 2, S, 128]
        v = v.view(B, S, self.n_kv, self.hd).transpose(1, 2)           # [B, 2, S, 128]

        # rotary position embedding (fp32 math)
        cos = self.rope_cos[:S][None, None]
        sin = self.rope_sin[:S][None, None]
        qf, kf = q.float(), k.float()
        q = (qf * cos + _rotate_half(qf) * sin).to(self.dt)
        k = (kf * cos + _rotate_half(kf) * sin).to(self.dt)

        # GQA: replicate each KV head for its n_rep query heads
        k = k[:, :, None].expand(B, self.n_kv, self.n_rep, S, self.hd).reshape(B, self.n_q, S, self.hd)
        v = v[:, :, None].expand(B, self.n_kv, self.n_rep, S, self.hd).reshape(B, self.n_q, S, self.hd)

        # causal scaled-dot-product attention (scale = 1/sqrt(head_dim))
        a = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v, is_causal=True)    # [B, 8, S, 128]
        a = a.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, S, H)

        # output projection + residual
        return residual + F.linear(a, self.w_o)


def get_inputs():
    g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(42)
    x = torch.randn(BATCH, SEQ, HIDDEN, generator=g)
    return [x.to(device=_DEVICE, dtype=DT)]

    #   RMSNorm -> fused QKV+gate proj -> per-head QK-RMSNorm -> RoPE

    # B=4, H=32, S=2048, D=64, E=2048; fp16 weights/activations, fp32 norm/rope math.
    B, H, S, D = 4, 32, 2048, 64
    E = H * D
    EPS = 1e-6
    ROPE_THETA = 10000.0

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        e, d, s = self.E, self.D, self.S
        dev = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
        g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(1234)

        def p(t):
            return nn.Parameter(t.to(device=dev, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)

        def rnd(*shape, std):
            return torch.randn(*shape, generator=g) * std

        self.norm_w = p(torch.ones(e))
        self.w_qkvg = p(rnd(4 * e, e, std=e ** -0.5))
        self.b_qkvg = p(rnd(4 * e, std=0.02))
        self.q_norm_w = p(torch.ones(d))
        self.k_norm_w = p(torch.ones(d))
        self.w_o = p(rnd(e, e, std=e ** -0.5))
        self.b_o = p(torch.zeros(e))

        inv_freq = 1.0 / (self.ROPE_THETA ** (torch.arange(0, d, 2, dtype=torch.float32) / d))
        freqs = torch.outer(torch.arange(s, dtype=torch.float32), inv_freq)
        emb = torch.cat((freqs, freqs), dim=-1)
        self.register_buffer("rope_cos", emb.cos().to(dev), persistent=False)
        self.register_buffer("rope_sin", emb.sin().to(dev), persistent=False)

    @staticmethod
    def _rms_norm(t, w, eps):
        tf = t.float()
        return tf * torch.rsqrt(tf.pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True) + eps) * w.float()

    @staticmethod
    def _rotate_half(t):
        h = t.shape[-1] // 2
        return torch.cat((-t[..., h:], t[..., :h]), dim=-1)

    def forward(self, x):
        b, s, e = x.shape
        h, d = self.H, self.D
        # pre-norm (fp32 statistics)
        hn = self._rms_norm(x, self.norm_w, self.EPS).to(x.dtype)
        # fused Q/K/V/gate projection
        qkvg = F.linear(hn, self.w_qkvg, self.b_qkvg)
        q, k, v, gate = qkvg.split(e, dim=-1)
        q = q.view(b, s, h, d).transpose(1, 2)
        k = k.view(b, s, h, d).transpose(1, 2)
        v = v.view(b, s, h, d).transpose(1, 2)
        # per-head QK-norm + RoPE (fp32)
        q = self._rms_norm(q, self.q_norm_w, self.EPS)
        k = self._rms_norm(k, self.k_norm_w, self.EPS)
        cos, sin = self.rope_cos[:s], self.rope_sin[:s]
        q = (q * cos + self._rotate_half(q) * sin).to(x.dtype)
        k = (k * cos + self._rotate_half(k) * sin).to(x.dtype)
        # causal attention
        o = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v, is_causal=True)
        o = o.transpose(1, 2).reshape(b, s, e)
        # sigmoid output gate, out-proj, residual
        o = o * torch.sigmoid(gate.float()).to(x.dtype)
        return x + F.linear(o, self.w_o, self.b_o)


def get_inputs():
    g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(4321)
    dev = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    x = torch.randn(Model.B, Model.S, Model.E, generator=g).to(device=dev, dtype=DT)
    return [x]

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

DT = torch.float16


class Model(nn.Module):
    # Llama/Qwen-style pre-norm GQA attention block:
    # RMSNorm -> fused QKV proj (+bias) -> RoPE(q,k) -> causal GQA SDPA (8 Q heads / 2 KV heads)
    # -> out proj -> residual add.   x: (B, S, D) fp16 -> (B, S, D) fp16
    B, S, D, H, KVH, DH = 8, 2048, 1024, 8, 2, 128
    EPS = 1e-6
    ROPE_THETA = 10000.0

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        dev = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
        g = torch.Generator(device=dev).manual_seed(1234)
        D, H, KVH, DH, S = self.D, self.H, self.KVH, self.DH, self.S
        KVD = KVH * DH
        self.norm_w = nn.Parameter(
            (1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(D, generator=g, device=dev, dtype=torch.float32)).to(dt),
            requires_grad=False)
        self.w_qkv = nn.Parameter(
            (torch.randn(D + 2 * KVD, D, generator=g, device=dev, dtype=torch.float32) / (D ** 0.5)).to(dt),
            requires_grad=False)
        self.b_qkv = nn.Parameter(
            (0.02 * torch.randn(D + 2 * KVD, generator=g, device=dev, dtype=torch.float32)).to(dt),
            requires_grad=False)
        self.w_o = nn.Parameter(
            (torch.randn(D, D, generator=g, device=dev, dtype=torch.float32) / (D ** 0.5)).to(dt),
            requires_grad=False)
        inv_freq = 1.0 / (self.ROPE_THETA ** (torch.arange(0, DH, 2, device=dev, dtype=torch.float32) / DH))
        t = torch.arange(S, device=dev, dtype=torch.float32)
        freqs = torch.outer(t, inv_freq)
        emb = torch.cat([freqs, freqs], dim=-1)
        self.register_buffer("cos", emb.cos(), persistent=False)  # (S, DH) fp32
        self.register_buffer("sin", emb.sin(), persistent=False)  # (S, DH) fp32

    @staticmethod
    def _rotate_half(x):
        x1, x2 = x.chunk(2, dim=-1)
        return torch.cat([-x2, x1], dim=-1)

    def _rope(self, x):
        # x: (B, S, nH, DH) fp16 -> rotate in fp32 -> fp16
        S = x.shape[1]
        xf = x.float()
        cos = self.cos[:S][None, :, None, :]
        sin = self.sin[:S][None, :, None, :]
        return (xf * cos + self._rotate_half(xf) * sin).to(x.dtype)

    def forward(self, x):
        B, S, D = x.shape
        H, KVH, DH = self.H, self.KVH, self.DH
        KVD = KVH * DH
        # RMSNorm (fp32 statistics)
        xf = x.float()
        h = xf * torch.rsqrt(xf.pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True) + self.EPS)
        h = (h * self.norm_w.float()).to(x.dtype)
        # fused QKV projection
        qkv = F.linear(h, self.w_qkv, self.b_qkv)
        q, k, v = qkv.split([D, KVD, KVD], dim=-1)
        q = self._rope(q.view(B, S, H, DH)).transpose(1, 2)      # (B, H,   S, DH)
        k = self._rope(k.view(B, S, KVH, DH)).transpose(1, 2)    # (B, KVH, S, DH)
        v = v.view(B, S, KVH, DH).transpose(1, 2)                # (B, KVH, S, DH)
        # grouped-query: each KV head serves H // KVH consecutive Q heads
        k = k.repeat_interleave(H // KVH, dim=1)
        v = v.repeat_interleave(H // KVH, dim=1)
        o = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v, is_causal=True)  # (B, H, S, DH)
        o = o.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, S, D)
        # output projection + residual
        return x + F.linear(o, self.w_o)


def get_inputs():
    dev = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    g = torch.Generator(device=dev).manual_seed(4321)
    x = torch.randn(Model.B, Model.S, Model.D, generator=g, device=dev, dtype=torch.float32)
    return [x.to(DT)]

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

DT = torch.float16


class Model(nn.Module):
    """
    Pre-norm transformer MLP sub-block, LLaMA-7B geometry with exact-erf GELU:

        h   = RMSNorm_fp32(x) * g                  # [4096, 4096]
        a   = gelu(h @ W1^T + b1)                  # [4096, 11008]
        out = x + (a @ W2^T + b2)                  # [4096, 4096]

    All tensors are fp16 except the RMSNorm statistics (computed in fp32).
    Fusion target: norm -> GEMM(+bias+GELU epilogue) -> GEMM(+bias+residual epilogue).
    """
    ROWS = 4096      # batch * seq
    DIM = 4096       # model width
    HIDDEN = 11008   # MLP intermediate width
    EPS = 1e-5

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        dev = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
        gen = torch.Generator().manual_seed(1234)  # fixed seed -> deterministic weights
        D, H = self.DIM, self.HIDDEN
        w1 = torch.randn(H, D, generator=gen) * (D ** -0.5)
        b1 = torch.randn(H, generator=gen) * 0.02
        w2 = torch.randn(D, H, generator=gen) * (H ** -0.5)
        b2 = torch.randn(D, generator=gen) * 0.02
        g = 1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(D, generator=gen)
        mk = lambda t: nn.Parameter(t.to(device=dev, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.w1, self.b1 = mk(w1), mk(b1)
        self.w2, self.b2 = mk(w2), mk(b2)
        self.norm_w = mk(g)

    def forward(self, x):
        # RMSNorm with fp32 statistics, cast back to activation dtype
        xf = x.float()
        inv_rms = torch.rsqrt(xf.pow(2).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + self.EPS)
        h = (xf * inv_rms).to(x.dtype) * self.norm_w
        # two-layer MLP with exact (erf) GELU
        a = F.gelu(F.linear(h, self.w1, self.b1))
        y = F.linear(a, self.w2, self.b2)
        # residual connection
        return x + y


def get_inputs():
    dev = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    gen = torch.Generator().manual_seed(4321)
    x = torch.randn(Model.ROWS, Model.DIM, generator=gen)
    return [x.to(device=dev, dtype=DT)]

import math
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

DT = torch.float16

# Problem size (LLM-style shapes: hidden = heads * head_dim = 1024)
BATCH = 8
SEQ = 1024
HEADS = 16
HEAD_DIM = 64
HIDDEN = HEADS * HEAD_DIM
LN_EPS = 1e-5


class Model(nn.Module):
    """
    Full pre-norm multi-head self-attention block (no mask, no dropout):

        h   = LayerNorm(x) * g + b                          # over last dim, eps=1e-5
        qkv = h @ Wqkv^T + bqkv                             # [B,S,3H] -> q | k | v
        a_h = softmax(q_h k_h^T / sqrt(64)) v_h             # per head, over all 1024 keys
        y   = x + (concat_heads(a) @ Wo^T + bo)             # residual add

    Optimization target: fuse LN + QKV GEMM + flash-style attention + out-proj
    + bias + residual and beat torch.compile on the whole block.
    """

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
        self.dt = dt
        self.heads = HEADS
        self.head_dim = HEAD_DIM
        self.hidden = HIDDEN
        self.eps = LN_EPS
        self.scale = 1.0 / math.sqrt(HEAD_DIM)

        # Deterministic init, independent of global RNG state and device.
        g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(1234)
        h = HIDDEN

        def rn(*shape, std=1.0):
            return torch.randn(*shape, generator=g, dtype=torch.float32) * std

        def P(t):
            return nn.Parameter(t.to(device=device, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)

        # LayerNorm affine params (non-trivial so the affine path is exercised)
        self.ln_weight = P(1.0 + 0.1 * rn(h))
        self.ln_bias = P(0.1 * rn(h))
        # Fused QKV projection [3H, H]  (rows: q | k | v), unit-variance outputs
        self.qkv_weight = P(rn(3 * h, h, std=1.0 / math.sqrt(h)))
        self.qkv_bias = P(rn(3 * h, std=0.02))
        # Output projection [H, H]
        self.out_weight = P(rn(h, h, std=1.0 / math.sqrt(h)))
        self.out_bias = P(rn(h, std=0.02))

    def forward(self, x):
        B, S, H = x.shape
        nh, hd = self.heads, self.head_dim
        # 1) pre-norm
        hN = F.layer_norm(x, (H,), self.ln_weight, self.ln_bias, self.eps)
        # 2) fused QKV projection
        qkv = F.linear(hN, self.qkv_weight, self.qkv_bias)              # [B, S, 3H]
        q, k, v = qkv.split(H, dim=-1)
        q = q.view(B, S, nh, hd).transpose(1, 2)                        # [B, nh, S, hd]
        k = k.view(B, S, nh, hd).transpose(1, 2)
        v = v.view(B, S, nh, hd).transpose(1, 2)
        # 3) multi-head scaled dot-product attention (no mask, no dropout)
        a = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(
            q, k, v, attn_mask=None, dropout_p=0.0, is_causal=False, scale=self.scale
        )                                                                # [B, nh, S, hd]
        a = a.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, S, H)                           # [B, S, H]
        # 4) output projection + bias + residual
        return x + F.linear(a, self.out_weight, self.out_bias)


def get_inputs():
    device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(4321)
    x = torch.randn(BATCH, SEQ, HIDDEN, generator=g, dtype=torch.float32)
    return [x.to(device=device, dtype=DT)]

import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

DT = torch.float16

BATCH = 8
SEQ = 1024
DIM = 2048
HIDDEN = 5632
EPS = 1e-6

_DEVICE = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")


class Model(nn.Module):
    """
    Llama-style pre-norm SwiGLU MLP block (fp16 storage, fp32 norm statistics):
        h   = RMSNorm(x) * norm_weight
        g   = h @ gate_proj^T
        u   = h @ up_proj^T
        a   = SiLU(g) * u
        out = x + a @ down_proj^T
    """

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        self.dt = dt
        self.eps = EPS

        gen = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(0x5EED)
        norm_w = 1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(DIM, generator=gen)
        gate_w = torch.randn(HIDDEN, DIM, generator=gen) * (DIM ** -0.5)
        up_w = torch.randn(HIDDEN, DIM, generator=gen) * (DIM ** -0.5)
        down_w = torch.randn(DIM, HIDDEN, generator=gen) * (HIDDEN ** -0.5)

        self.norm_weight = nn.Parameter(norm_w.to(device=_DEVICE, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.gate_proj = nn.Parameter(gate_w.to(device=_DEVICE, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.up_proj = nn.Parameter(up_w.to(device=_DEVICE, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.down_proj = nn.Parameter(down_w.to(device=_DEVICE, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)

    def forward(self, x):
        residual = x
        # RMSNorm with fp32 statistics, output cast back to fp16 before scaling
        xf = x.float()
        var = xf.pow(2).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
        h = (xf * torch.rsqrt(var + self.eps)).to(self.dt) * self.norm_weight
        # SwiGLU
        gate = F.linear(h, self.gate_proj)
        up = F.linear(h, self.up_proj)
        act = F.silu(gate) * up
        # down projection + residual
        out = F.linear(act, self.down_proj)
        return residual + out


def get_inputs():
    gen = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(1234)
    x = torch.randn(BATCH, SEQ, DIM, generator=gen)
    return [x.to(device=_DEVICE, dtype=DT)]

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

DT = torch.float16

BATCH = 4
HEADS = 32
SEQ = 2048
HEAD_DIM = 64
EMBED = HEADS * HEAD_DIM  # 2048
ROPE_BASE = 10000.0
EPS = 1e-5


def _device():
    return torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")


class Model(nn.Module):
    # Pre-norm causal self-attention block (LLaMA style), fp16 end to end:
    #   h        = RMSNorm(x) * g                    (stats in fp32)
    #   q, k, v  = split(h @ Wqkv^T)                 (fused QKV GEMM, E -> 3E)
    #   q, k     = RoPE(q), RoPE(k)                  (rotate-half, precomputed cos/sin)
    #   a        = softmax(q k^T / sqrt(D) + causal) v
    #   y        = x + a @ Wo^T                      (out-proj + residual)
    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        dev = _device()
        gen = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(1234)
        self.heads = HEADS
        self.head_dim = HEAD_DIM
        self.eps = EPS

        norm_w = 1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(EMBED, generator=gen)
        w_qkv = torch.randn(3 * EMBED, EMBED, generator=gen) * (EMBED ** -0.5)
        w_o = torch.randn(EMBED, EMBED, generator=gen) * (EMBED ** -0.5)
        self.norm_w = nn.Parameter(norm_w.to(device=dev, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.w_qkv = nn.Parameter(w_qkv.to(device=dev, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.w_o = nn.Parameter(w_o.to(device=dev, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)

        inv_freq = 1.0 / (ROPE_BASE ** (torch.arange(0, HEAD_DIM, 2, dtype=torch.float32) / HEAD_DIM))
        pos = torch.arange(SEQ, dtype=torch.float32)
        freqs = torch.outer(pos, inv_freq)          # [S, D/2]
        emb = torch.cat([freqs, freqs], dim=-1)     # [S, D]
        self.register_buffer("rope_cos", emb.cos().to(device=dev, dtype=dt), persistent=False)
        self.register_buffer("rope_sin", emb.sin().to(device=dev, dtype=dt), persistent=False)

    @staticmethod
    def _rotate_half(t):
        d = t.shape[-1] // 2
        return torch.cat((-t[..., d:], t[..., :d]), dim=-1)

    def forward(self, x):
        B, S, E = x.shape
        H, D = self.heads, self.head_dim

        # RMSNorm (fp32 statistics) + gain
        xf = x.float()
        h = xf * torch.rsqrt(xf.pow(2).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + self.eps)
        h = h.to(x.dtype) * self.norm_w

        # Fused QKV projection, split into heads
        qkv = F.linear(h, self.w_qkv)                       # [B, S, 3E]
        q, k, v = qkv.split(E, dim=-1)
        q = q.view(B, S, H, D).transpose(1, 2)              # [B, H, S, D]
        k = k.view(B, S, H, D).transpose(1, 2)
        v = v.view(B, S, H, D).transpose(1, 2)

        # Rotary position embedding on q and k
        cos = self.rope_cos[:S]
        sin = self.rope_sin[:S]
        q = q * cos + self._rotate_half(q) * sin
        k = k * cos + self._rotate_half(k) * sin

        # Causal scaled-dot-product attention
        o = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v, is_causal=True, scale=D ** -0.5)  # [B, H, S, D]
        o = o.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, S, E)

        # Output projection + residual
        return x + F.linear(o, self.w_o)


def get_inputs():
    gen = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(0)
    x = torch.randn(BATCH, SEQ, EMBED, generator=gen)
    return [x.to(device=_device(), dtype=DT)]

HIDDEN = 4096
EPS = 1e-5


class Model(nn.Module):
    """
    Pre-LN square MLP sub-block of a transformer:
        y = x + W2 @ gelu(W1 @ LN(x) + b1) + b2
    x: [BATCH, SEQ, HIDDEN] fp16 -> 8192 rows x 4096.
    LayerNorm statistics are computed in fp32; GEMMs run in fp16 (fp32 accumulate).
    """

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        self.dt = dt
        device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
        g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(1234)
        std = HIDDEN ** -0.5

        def P(t):
            return nn.Parameter(t.to(device=device, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)

        self.ln_w = P(1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(HIDDEN, generator=g))
        self.ln_b = P(0.1 * torch.randn(HIDDEN, generator=g))
        self.w1 = P(torch.randn(HIDDEN, HIDDEN, generator=g) * std)
        self.b1 = P(0.02 * torch.randn(HIDDEN, generator=g))
        self.w2 = P(torch.randn(HIDDEN, HIDDEN, generator=g) * std)
        self.b2 = P(0.02 * torch.randn(HIDDEN, generator=g))

    def forward(self, x):
        h = F.layer_norm(
            x.float(), (HIDDEN,), self.ln_w.float(), self.ln_b.float(), EPS

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

DT = torch.float16
_DEV = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")

BATCH, SEQ, HIDDEN = 8, 2048, 1024
N_Q_HEADS, N_KV_HEADS, HEAD_DIM = 8, 2, 128
KV_DIM = N_KV_HEADS * HEAD_DIM
EPS = 1e-6
ROPE_BASE = 10000.0


def _rms_norm(x, w, eps):
    xf = x.float()
    xf = xf * torch.rsqrt(xf.pow(2).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + eps)
    return (xf * w.float()).to(x.dtype)


def _rotate_half(x):
    x1, x2 = x.chunk(2, dim=-1)
    return torch.cat((-x2, x1), dim=-1)


class Model(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(1234)

        def rand(*shape, std=1.0, mean=0.0):
            t = mean + std * torch.randn(*shape, generator=g, dtype=torch.float32)
            return t.to(_DEV, dt)

        self.norm_w = nn.Parameter(rand(HIDDEN, std=0.05, mean=1.0))
        self.q_norm_w = nn.Parameter(rand(HEAD_DIM, std=0.05, mean=1.0))
        self.k_norm_w = nn.Parameter(rand(HEAD_DIM, std=0.05, mean=1.0))
        self.w_qkv = nn.Parameter(rand(HIDDEN + 2 * KV_DIM, HIDDEN, std=HIDDEN ** -0.5))
        self.w_o = nn.Parameter(rand(HIDDEN, HIDDEN, std=HIDDEN ** -0.5))

        inv_freq = 1.0 / (ROPE_BASE ** (torch.arange(0, HEAD_DIM, 2, dtype=torch.float32) / HEAD_DIM))
        pos = torch.arange(SEQ, dtype=torch.float32)
        freqs = torch.outer(pos, inv_freq)
        emb = torch.cat((freqs, freqs), dim=-1)
        self.register_buffer("rope_cos", emb.cos().to(_DEV), persistent=False)
        self.register_buffer("rope_sin", emb.sin().to(_DEV), persistent=False)

    def forward(self, x):
        b, s, _ = x.shape
        h = _rms_norm(x, self.norm_w, EPS)
        qkv = F.linear(h, self.w_qkv)
        q, k, v = qkv.split([HIDDEN, KV_DIM, KV_DIM], dim=-1)
        q = q.view(b, s, N_Q_HEADS, HEAD_DIM).transpose(1, 2)
        k = k.view(b, s, N_KV_HEADS, HEAD_DIM).transpose(1, 2)
        v = v.view(b, s, N_KV_HEADS, HEAD_DIM).transpose(1, 2)
        q = _rms_norm(q, self.q_norm_w, EPS)
        k = _rms_norm(k, self.k_norm_w, EPS)
        cos = self.rope_cos[:s]
        sin = self.rope_sin[:s]
        qf, kf = q.float(), k.float()
        q = (qf * cos + _rotate_half(qf) * sin).to(x.dtype)
        k = (kf * cos + _rotate_half(kf) * sin).to(x.dtype)
        rep = N_Q_HEADS // N_KV_HEADS
        k = k.repeat_interleave(rep, dim=1)
        v = v.repeat_interleave(rep, dim=1)
        o = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v, is_causal=True)
        o = o.transpose(1, 2).reshape(b, s, HIDDEN)
        return x + F.linear(o, self.w_o)


def get_inputs():
    g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(42)
    x = torch.randn(BATCH, SEQ, HIDDEN, generator=g, dtype=torch.float32)
    return [x.to(_DEV, DT)]

import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

DT = torch.float16

ROWS = 4096      # batch * seq
DIM = 4096       # model width
HIDDEN = 11008   # MLP hidden width
EPS = 1e-5


def _device():
    return torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")


class Model(nn.Module):
    """
    Pre-norm transformer MLP sub-block (fp16 storage, fp32 norm statistics,
    fp32-accumulated fp16 GEMMs):

        y = x + W2 @ gelu_tanh( W1 @ rmsnorm(x) )

    Fusion surface: rmsnorm -> GEMM(4096->11008) -> gelu -> GEMM(11008->4096) -> residual add.
    """

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        dev = _device()
        g = torch.Generator(device=dev).manual_seed(1234)
        w1 = torch.randn(HIDDEN, DIM, generator=g, device=dev, dtype=torch.float32) * 0.02
        w2 = torch.randn(DIM, HIDDEN, generator=g, device=dev, dtype=torch.float32) * 0.01
        nw = 1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(DIM, generator=g, device=dev, dtype=torch.float32)
        self.w1 = nn.Parameter(w1.to(dt), requires_grad=False)       # [HIDDEN, DIM]
        self.w2 = nn.Parameter(w2.to(dt), requires_grad=False)       # [DIM, HIDDEN]
        self.norm_w = nn.Parameter(nw.to(dt), requires_grad=False)   # [DIM]
        self.eps = EPS

    def forward(self, x):
        # RMSNorm with fp32 statistics, output cast back to activation dtype
        xf = x.float()
        var = xf.pow(2).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
        h = (xf * torch.rsqrt(var + self.eps) * self.norm_w.float()).to(x.dtype)
        # up-projection + GELU (tanh approximation)
        h = F.linear(h, self.w1)
        h = F.gelu(h, approximate="tanh")
        # down-projection + residual
        h = F.linear(h, self.w2)
        return x + h


def get_inputs():
    dev = _device()
    g = torch.Generator(device=dev).manual_seed(42)
    x = torch.randn(ROWS, DIM, generator=g, device=dev, dtype=torch.float32).to(DT)
    return [x]

import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

DT = torch.float16


class Model(nn.Module):
    # Pre-norm self-attention block written as explicit, unfused ops:
    #   y = x + W_o( MHA( LayerNorm(x) ) )      B=8, S=1024, H=16, Dh=64 (D=1024)
    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        self.d_model = 1024
        self.n_heads = 16
        self.head_dim = self.d_model // self.n_heads          # 64
        self.scale = self.head_dim ** -0.5                    # 1/sqrt(64)
        self.eps = 1e-5

        device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
        g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(0)
        d = self.d_model

        def param(t):
            return nn.Parameter(t.to(device=device, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)

        # LayerNorm affine (non-trivial gamma/beta so they cannot be skipped)
        self.ln_w = param(1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(d, generator=g))
        self.ln_b = param(0.1 * torch.randn(d, generator=g))
        # Fused QKV projection: [3D, D] (+bias); scaled so attention logits have std ~2
        self.w_qkv = param(torch.randn(3 * d, d, generator=g) * (2.0 / d) ** 0.5)
        self.b_qkv = param(0.02 * torch.randn(3 * d, generator=g))
        # Output projection: [D, D] (+bias)
        self.w_o = param(torch.randn(d, d, generator=g) * (1.0 / d) ** 0.5)
        self.b_o = param(0.02 * torch.randn(d, generator=g))

    def forward(self, x):
        B, S, D = x.shape
        H, Dh = self.n_heads, self.head_dim

        # 1) pre-norm
        h = F.layer_norm(x, (D,), self.ln_w, self.ln_b, self.eps)          # [B, S, D]

        # 2) QKV projection + head split
        qkv = F.linear(h, self.w_qkv, self.b_qkv)                          # [B, S, 3D]
        qkv = qkv.view(B, S, 3, H, Dh).permute(2, 0, 3, 1, 4)              # [3, B, H, S, Dh]
        q, k, v = qkv[0], qkv[1], qkv[2]                                   # each [B, H, S, Dh]

        # 3) scaled dot-product attention (no mask), materialized
        attn = torch.matmul(q, k.transpose(-2, -1)) * self.scale           # [B, H, S, S]
        attn = torch.softmax(attn, dim=-1)
        o = torch.matmul(attn, v)                                          # [B, H, S, Dh]

        # 4) merge heads + output projection
        o = o.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, S, D)                             # [B, S, D]
        o = F.linear(o, self.w_o, self.b_o)

        # 5) residual
        return x + o


def get_inputs():
    device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(1234)
    x = torch.randn(8, 1024, 1024, generator=g).to(device=device, dtype=DT)
    return [x]

DT = torch.float16

BATCH, SEQ, DIM, HIDDEN = 8, 1024, 2048, 5632
EPS = 1e-6


class Model(nn.Module):
    """Full SwiGLU MLP block (LLaMA-style):
        n   = RMSNorm(x) * w_norm
        y   = x + W_down( SiLU(W_gate n) * (W_up n) )
    x: (BATCH, SEQ, DIM) fp16 -> y: (BATCH, SEQ, DIM) fp16
    """

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(1234)
        norm_w = 1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(DIM, generator=g)
        w_gate = torch.randn(HIDDEN, DIM, generator=g) * (DIM ** -0.5)
        w_up = torch.randn(HIDDEN, DIM, generator=g) * (DIM ** -0.5)
        w_down = torch.randn(DIM, HIDDEN, generator=g) * (HIDDEN ** -0.5)
        self.norm_weight = nn.Parameter(norm_w.to(device=_DEV, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.gate_proj = nn.Parameter(w_gate.to(device=_DEV, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.up_proj = nn.Parameter(w_up.to(device=_DEV, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.down_proj = nn.Parameter(w_down.to(device=_DEV, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.eps = EPS

    def forward(self, x):
        # RMSNorm computed in fp32 for numerical stability, cast back to fp16
        h = x.float()
        h = h * torch.rsqrt(h.pow(2).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + self.eps)
        h = (h * self.norm_weight.float()).to(x.dtype)
        # SwiGLU: two projections, gated activation
        gate = F.linear(h, self.gate_proj)      # (B, S, HIDDEN)
        up = F.linear(h, self.up_proj)          # (B, S, HIDDEN)
        act = F.silu(gate) * up                 # (B, S, HIDDEN)
        # down projection
        out = F.linear(act, self.down_proj)     # (B, S, DIM)
        # residual add
        return x + out


def get_inputs():
    g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(42)
    x = torch.randn(BATCH, SEQ, DIM, generator=g)
    return [x.to(device=_DEV, dtype=DT)]

import torch.nn.functional as F

DT = torch.float16


class Model(nn.Module):
    """
    Llama-style pre-norm causal self-attention block (fp16):
        h    = RMSNorm(x) * gamma
        qkv  = h @ W_qkv^T                      (fused Q/K/V projection, no bias)
        q, k = RoPE(q), RoPE(k)                 (rotary position embedding)
        o    = CausalSoftmax(q k^T / sqrt(dh)) v    (32 heads, head_dim 64)
        y    = x + o @ W_o^T                    (output projection + residual)
    batch 4, seq 2048, d_model 2048 (32 x 64).
    """

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        dev = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
        self.dt = dt
        self.h, self.dh, self.s_max = 32, 64, 2048
        self.d = self.h * self.dh
        self.eps = 1e-5
        d, dh, s = self.d, self.dh, self.s_max

        g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(1234)
        w_qkv = torch.randn(3 * d, d, generator=g) * (d ** -0.5)
        w_o = torch.randn(d, d, generator=g) * (d ** -0.5)
        gamma = 1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(d, generator=g)
        self.w_qkv = nn.Parameter(w_qkv.to(device=dev, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.w_o = nn.Parameter(w_o.to(device=dev, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.gamma = nn.Parameter(gamma.to(device=dev, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)

        inv_freq = 1.0 / (10000.0 ** (torch.arange(0, dh, 2, dtype=torch.float32) / dh))
        pos = torch.arange(s, dtype=torch.float32)
        emb = torch.outer(pos, inv_freq).repeat(1, 2)  # (s, dh) = [freqs, freqs]
        self.register_buffer("cos", emb.cos().to(device=dev, dtype=dt).view(1, 1, s, dh), persistent=False)
        self.register_buffer("sin", emb.sin().to(device=dev, dtype=dt).view(1, 1, s, dh), persistent=False)

    @staticmethod
    def _rotate_half(t):
        n = t.shape[-1] // 2
        return torch.cat((-t[..., n:], t[..., :n]), dim=-1)

    def forward(self, x):
        b, s, d = x.shape
        # RMSNorm (fp32 statistics, fp16 output)
        xf = x.float()
        xn = (xf * torch.rsqrt(xf.pow(2).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + self.eps)).to(x.dtype) * self.gamma
        # fused QKV projection
        qkv = F.linear(xn, self.w_qkv)
        q, k, v = qkv.split(d, dim=-1)
        q = q.view(b, s, self.h, self.dh).transpose(1, 2)
        k = k.view(b, s, self.h, self.dh).transpose(1, 2)
        v = v.view(b, s, self.h, self.dh).transpose(1, 2)
        # rotary embeddings
        cos, sin = self.cos[:, :, :s], self.sin[:, :, :s]
        q = q * cos + self._rotate_half(q) * sin
        k = k * cos + self._rotate_half(k) * sin
        # causal multi-head attention
        o = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v, is_causal=True)
        o = o.transpose(1, 2).reshape(b, s, d)
        # output projection + residual
        return x + F.linear(o, self.w_o)

    g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(42)
    x = torch.randn(4, 2048, 2048, generator=g)
    return [x.to(device=dev, dtype=DT)]

import math
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

DT = torch.float16

# Llama-style pre-norm GQA attention block
B, S, NH, NKV, HD = 8, 2048, 8, 2, 128   # batch, seq, query heads, kv heads, head dim
H = NH * HD                               # hidden = 1024
KVD = NKV * HD                            # kv width = 256
EPS = 1e-6
ROPE_BASE = 10000.0


class Model(nn.Module):
    """
    x -> RMSNorm -> fused QKV projection -> RoPE(q, k) -> causal grouped-query attention
    (8 Q heads share 2 KV heads) -> output projection -> residual add.
    All weights are deterministic (seeded), created on the right device/dtype.
    """

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        dev = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
        g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(0)
        std = 1.0 / math.sqrt(H)
        w_qkv = torch.randn(H + 2 * KVD, H, generator=g) * std
        w_qkv[: H + KVD] *= math.sqrt(3.0)          # attention logits std ~3 (realistic, fp16-safe)
        w_o = torch.randn(H, H, generator=g) * std
        norm_w = 1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(H, generator=g)
        self.w_qkv = nn.Parameter(w_qkv.to(dev, dt), requires_grad=False)   # [1536, 1024]
        self.w_o = nn.Parameter(w_o.to(dev, dt), requires_grad=False)       # [1024, 1024]
        self.norm_w = nn.Parameter(norm_w.to(dev, dt), requires_grad=False) # [1024]
        inv_freq = 1.0 / (ROPE_BASE ** (torch.arange(0, HD, 2, dtype=torch.float32) / HD))
        pos = torch.arange(S, dtype=torch.float32)
        freqs = torch.outer(pos, inv_freq)                                   # [S, HD/2]
        self.register_buffer("cos", freqs.cos().to(dev), persistent=False)
        self.register_buffer("sin", freqs.sin().to(dev), persistent=False)
        self.dt = dt

    def _rmsnorm(self, x):
        xf = x.float()
        xf = xf * torch.rsqrt(xf.pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True) + EPS)
        return (xf * self.norm_w.float()).to(x.dtype)

    def _rope(self, t):
        # t: [B, heads, S, HD]; rotate-half convention, computed in fp32
        tf = t.float()
        t1, t2 = tf[..., : HD // 2], tf[..., HD // 2:]
        c = self.cos[: t.shape[2]]
        s = self.sin[: t.shape[2]]
        o1 = t1 * c - t2 * s
        o2 = t2 * c + t1 * s
        return torch.cat((o1, o2), dim=-1).to(t.dtype)

    def forward(self, x):
        b, s, _ = x.shape
        h = self._rmsnorm(x)
        qkv = F.linear(h, self.w_qkv)                              # [B, S, 1536]
        q, k, v = torch.split(qkv, [H, KVD, KVD], dim=-1)
        q = q.view(b, s, NH, HD).transpose(1, 2)                   # [B, 8, S, 128]
        k = k.view(b, s, NKV, HD).transpose(1, 2)                  # [B, 2, S, 128]
        v = v.view(b, s, NKV, HD).transpose(1, 2)                  # [B, 2, S, 128]
        q = self._rope(q)
        k = self._rope(k)
        rep = NH // NKV
        k = k.repeat_interleave(rep, dim=1)                        # [B, 8, S, 128]
        v = v.repeat_interleave(rep, dim=1)                        # [B, 8, S, 128]
        o = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v, is_causal=True)  # scale = 1/sqrt(128)
        o = o.transpose(1, 2).reshape(b, s, H)                     # [B, S, 1024]
        return x + F.linear(o, self.w_o)                           # residual


def get_inputs():
    dev = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(1)
    x = torch.randn(B, S, H, generator=g)
    return [x.to(dev, DT)]

import torch.nn.functional as F

DT = torch.float16


class Model(nn.Module):
    # Transformer MLP sub-block (fp16): y = x + gelu(x @ W1^T + b1) @ W2^T + b2
    # rows = B*S = 4096, d_model = 4096, d_hidden = 11008 -> two 4096x4096x11008 GEMMs
    # with bias+exact-erf-GELU and bias+residual epilogues (variance-preserving init,
    # all activations O(1), no fp16 overflow risk).
    B, S, D_MODEL, D_HIDDEN = 4, 1024, 4096, 11008

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
        g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(20240607)
        D, H = self.D_MODEL, self.D_HIDDEN
        # draw in fp32 on CPU for bit-reproducible weights, then cast/move
        w1 = torch.randn(H, D, generator=g, dtype=torch.float32) * (D ** -0.5)
        b1 = torch.randn(H, generator=g, dtype=torch.float32) * 0.02
        w2 = torch.randn(D, H, generator=g, dtype=torch.float32) * (H ** -0.5)
        b2 = torch.randn(D, generator=g, dtype=torch.float32) * 0.02
        self.w1 = nn.Parameter(w1.to(device=device, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.b1 = nn.Parameter(b1.to(device=device, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.w2 = nn.Parameter(w2.to(device=device, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.b2 = nn.Parameter(b2.to(device=device, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)

    def forward(self, x):
        # x: [B, S, D_MODEL] fp16
        h = F.linear(x, self.w1, self.b1)        # [B, S, D_HIDDEN]
        h = F.gelu(h, approximate="none")        # exact erf GELU
        y = F.linear(h, self.w2, self.b2)        # [B, S, D_MODEL]
        return x + y                             # residual


def get_inputs():
    device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")

def _dev():
    return torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")


class Model(nn.Module):
    """Pre-norm causal MHA block: RMSNorm -> fused QKV GEMM -> RoPE -> causal SDPA -> out-proj -> residual."""

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        self.H, self.hd, self.D = _H, _HD, _D
        self.eps = 1e-5
        dev = _dev()
        gen = torch.Generator().manual_seed(1234)

        def rnd(*shape, std):
            return torch.randn(*shape, generator=gen, dtype=torch.float32).mul_(std)

        self.g = nn.Parameter((1.0 + 0.1 * rnd(_D, std=1.0)).to(dev, dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.w_qkv = nn.Parameter(rnd(3 * _D, _D, std=_D ** -0.5).to(dev, dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.w_o = nn.Parameter(rnd(_D, _D, std=_D ** -0.5).to(dev, dt), requires_grad=False)

        inv_freq = 1.0 / (10000.0 ** (torch.arange(0, _HD, 2, dtype=torch.float64) / _HD))
        ang = torch.outer(torch.arange(_S, dtype=torch.float64), inv_freq)
        ang = torch.cat((ang, ang), dim=-1).view(1, 1, _S, _HD)
        self.register_buffer("cos", ang.cos().to(torch.float32).to(dev))
        self.register_buffer("sin", ang.sin().to(torch.float32).to(dev))

    def _rope(self, t, S):
        tf = t.float()
        h = self.hd // 2
        rot = torch.cat((-tf[..., h:], tf[..., :h]), dim=-1)
        return (tf * self.cos[:, :, :S] + rot * self.sin[:, :, :S]).to(t.dtype)

    def forward(self, x):
        B, S, D = x.shape
        xf = x.float()

        qkv = F.linear(h, self.w_qkv).view(B, S, 3, self.H, self.hd)
        q, k, v = qkv.unbind(2)
        q = self._rope(q.transpose(1, 2), S)
        k = self._rope(k.transpose(1, 2), S)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

DT = torch.float16


class Model(nn.Module):
    # Pre-norm grouped-query attention block (Llama-style):
    #   n = RMSNorm(x)
    #   q, k, v = split(n @ W_qkv^T)          # 8 Q heads, 2 KV heads, head_dim 128
    #   q, k = RoPE(q), RoPE(k)               # rotation applied in fp32
    #   o = CausalSDPA(q, expand(k), expand(v))
    #   y = x + o @ W_o^T
    BATCH = 8
    SEQ = 2048
    HIDDEN = 1024
    N_HEADS = 8
    N_KV_HEADS = 2
    HEAD_DIM = 128
    EPS = 1e-5
    ROPE_BASE = 10000.0
    SEED = 1234

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        dev = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
        g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(self.SEED)
        self.dt = dt
        self.n_heads = self.N_HEADS
        self.n_kv_heads = self.N_KV_HEADS
        self.head_dim = self.HEAD_DIM
        self.n_rep = self.N_HEADS // self.N_KV_HEADS
        self.eps = self.EPS
        self.q_dim = self.N_HEADS * self.HEAD_DIM
        self.kv_dim = self.N_KV_HEADS * self.HEAD_DIM
        std = 1.0 / math.sqrt(self.HIDDEN)
        self.norm_w = nn.Parameter(
            (1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(self.HIDDEN, generator=g)).to(dev, dt),
            requires_grad=False,
        )
        self.w_qkv = nn.Parameter(
            (torch.randn(self.q_dim + 2 * self.kv_dim, self.HIDDEN, generator=g) * std).to(dev, dt),
            requires_grad=False,
        )
        self.w_o = nn.Parameter(
            (torch.randn(self.HIDDEN, self.q_dim, generator=g) * std).to(dev, dt),
            requires_grad=False,
        )
        inv_freq = 1.0 / (
            self.ROPE_BASE ** (torch.arange(0, self.HEAD_DIM, 2, dtype=torch.float32) / self.HEAD_DIM)
        )
        freqs = torch.outer(torch.arange(self.SEQ, dtype=torch.float32), inv_freq)
        emb = torch.cat([freqs, freqs], dim=-1)  # [SEQ, HEAD_DIM], half-rotation layout
        self.register_buffer("rope_cos", emb.cos().to(dev), persistent=False)
        self.register_buffer("rope_sin", emb.sin().to(dev), persistent=False)

    @staticmethod
    def _rotate_half(x):
        x1, x2 = x.chunk(2, dim=-1)
        return torch.cat([-x2, x1], dim=-1)

    def _rope(self, x, cos, sin):
        xf = x.float()
        return (xf * cos + self._rotate_half(xf) * sin).to(x.dtype)

    def forward(self, x):
        B, S, C = x.shape
        # RMSNorm with fp32 statistics
        xf = x.float()
        h = (xf * torch.rsqrt(xf.pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True) + self.eps)).to(x.dtype) * self.norm_w
        # fused QKV projection
        qkv = F.linear(h, self.w_qkv)
        q, k, v = torch.split(qkv, [self.q_dim, self.kv_dim, self.kv_dim], dim=-1)
        q = q.view(B, S, self.n_heads, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
        k = k.view(B, S, self.n_kv_heads, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
        v = v.view(B, S, self.n_kv_heads, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
        # rotary embeddings
        cos, sin = self.rope_cos[:S], self.rope_sin[:S]
        q = self._rope(q, cos, sin)
        k = self._rope(k, cos, sin)
        # grouped-query: each KV head serves n_rep consecutive Q heads
        k = k.repeat_interleave(self.n_rep, dim=1)
        v = v.repeat_interleave(self.n_rep, dim=1)
        # causal attention, scale = 1/sqrt(head_dim)
        o = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v, is_causal=True)
        o = o.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, S, self.q_dim)
        # output projection + residual
        return x + F.linear(o, self.w_o)


def get_inputs():
    g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(Model.SEED + 1)
    x = torch.randn(Model.BATCH, Model.SEQ, Model.HIDDEN, generator=g)
    return [x.to(torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"), DT)]

class Model(nn.Module):
    """Pre-norm multi-head self-attention block (no mask), y = x + W_o(MHA(LN(x))).
    B=8, S=1024, H=16, head_dim=64, d_model=1024."""

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        self.dt = dt
        self.H = 16
        self.hd = 64
        self.D = self.H * self.hd  # 1024
        self.eps = 1e-5
        self.scale = 1.0 / (self.hd ** 0.5)
        dev = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
        g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(1234)
        D = self.D

        def param(t):
            return nn.Parameter(t.to(device=dev, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)

        self.ln_w = param(1.0 + 0.05 * torch.randn(D, generator=g))
        self.ln_b = param(0.05 * torch.randn(D, generator=g))
        self.w_qkv = param(torch.randn(3 * D, D, generator=g) * (D ** -0.5))
        self.b_qkv = param(0.02 * torch.randn(3 * D, generator=g))
        self.w_o = param(torch.randn(D, D, generator=g) * (D ** -0.5))
        self.b_o = param(0.02 * torch.randn(D, generator=g))

    def forward(self, x):
        B, S, D = x.shape
        H, hd = self.H, self.hd
        # LayerNorm (statistics and affine in fp32, single cast back)
        xf = x.float()
        mu = xf.mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
        var = xf.var(dim=-1, keepdim=True, unbiased=False)
        h = (xf - mu) * torch.rsqrt(var + self.eps)
        h = (h * self.ln_w.float() + self.ln_b.float()).to(x.dtype)
        # Fused QKV projection
        qkv = nn.functional.linear(h, self.w_qkv, self.b_qkv)  # (B, S, 3D)
        q, k, v = qkv.split(D, dim=-1)
        q = q.reshape(B, S, H, hd).transpose(1, 2)  # (B, H, S, hd)
        k = k.reshape(B, S, H, hd).transpose(1, 2)
        v = v.reshape(B, S, H, hd).transpose(1, 2)
        # Multi-head scaled dot-product attention, no mask
        scores = torch.matmul(q, k.transpose(-2, -1)) * self.scale  # (B, H, S, S)
        probs = torch.softmax(scores, dim=-1, dtype=torch.float32).to(x.dtype)
        o = torch.matmul(probs, v)  # (B, H, S, hd)
        o = o.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, S, D)
        # Output projection + residual
        out = nn.functional.linear(o, self.w_o, self.b_o)
        return x + out

    g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(4321)
    x = torch.randn(8, 1024, 1024, generator=g).to(device=dev, dtype=DT)
